bannedPublicWording.rule: Never: prescribe, وصفة or يصف; treat or treatment as what Azm does; diagnose or يشخّص as what Azm does (D-017: with no disclaimer left, this rule is the protection at the regulatory line); rehabilitation program; manage spasticity; recovery; prove, proof or إثبات; progress or تقدم in user facing copy; patients for users; monitor for clinicians. Never the expansion Smart Personalized Assessment of Range and Kinematics in new copy, and never عزم سبارك or any transliteration of SPARK in Arabic (H2): the product is عزم alone in Arabic.
bannedPublicWording.manual: treat as what Azm does, and monitor for clinicians, are checked by the copy review, because the words also have allowed uses (a blood pressure monitor).

surgeryAreas.rule: An area the check cannot place takes the widest listed restriction, the chest_belly load set (R3C-27); its clearance question is asked as for every area. A yes to pc_surgery_recent with no listed area applies the same set.

pose.subjectLock: At calibration the subject is the seated (or, for the chair stand, the calibrating) person nearest the frame centre. Each frame, the subject is the pose whose mid hip is nearest the subject’s calibration mid hip, tracked frame to frame. A second pose that stays at the frame edge is ignored. The helper’s body points are used on the phone only, in memory, to lock onto the person; they are never stored or sent (Q11).
pauseWhen: a second pose’s bounding box overlaps the subject’s by more than 20 percent
the subject’s mid hip jumps by more than 0.5 shoulder widths in one frame
pose.onPause: Pause scoring and cue check_one_person. An attempt with more than 10 percent paused frames fails the quality gate. An attempt in which the second person touches the subject is invalid.
pose.setupGate: one person in the chair; a helper may stand at the side (replaces the old one person gate)

model.choice: At the baseline of a series, use Full on a device that sustains 20 fps or more during the setup check, and Lite otherwise. The model is then kept for the series; if a later device cannot sustain the floor with that model, the series changes (range tests: not comparable; timed counts: wide band).
model.basis: The BlazePose GHUM 3D model card reports average PDJ (PCK at 0.2) of 87.0 for Lite, 91.8 for Full and 94.2 for Heavy, and a worst skin tone group of 80.5 for Lite against 85.9 for Full.

engine.landmarks: Each test lists gate landmarks and optional landmarks. Only gate landmarks can fail an attempt (visibility at least the test minimum in at least 90 percent of frames, architecture section 5). Optional landmarks feed flags and compensation checks; when not visible the flag is stored as unknown.

soundCheck.onNo: scr_sound_off, then the sound check again; if the answer is still no, scr_sound_still_off and the check may continue
soundCheck.audioSession: Set the audio session to playback where the browser allows it (iOS mutes Web Audio on the silent switch otherwise).

coachingTrunkStop.relativeRule: the trunk moves 15 degrees or more away from the person's own calibrated posture, in either direction
coachingTrunkStop.curlForward: taken at calibration from the side of the mid shoulder the face is on (nose, landmark 0); backward = toward the backrest or a tilted wheelchair
coachingTrunkStop.blockStart: If the calibrated posture is already at or beyond the absolute cap in that direction (press 25 either way; curl forward 25 or more, backward 30 or more), the set does not start and the app shows cue.

coachingTrunkStop.record: A safety relevant design change: engineVersion bump and a risk file entry with the before and after firing angles (d003-aspect-impact.md: the old absolute 25 fired at a true 14.7 in portrait and 39.7 in landscape), signed by the medical lead before the deploy.
coachingTrunkStop.tests: tests/geometry-aspect.test.ts gains the stop cases: upright and 5, 15 and 20 degree calibrated leans, portrait and landscape, plus curl cases calibrated at 20 forward and 20 backward.
coachingTrunkStop.retune: Both limits are retuned after the booth from the anonymous stop counts (Q25).

precheckRules.interaction: One question per screen. Each answer is a full width button at least 56 px tall with text, none preselected, and an answer counts only when the press starts and ends on the same button. A tap submits and moves on, except on the 0 to 10 pain scales (painScale: pc_pain_now, pc_pain_areas), which use select, then Next, with the readout «اخترت {value}» · You chose {value}. Answers that open scr_emergency or scr_ad, sf_faint_loc yes or not sure, pc_faint_since yes and pc_sci_ready Not yet route at once. A visible Back; no time limit on any question screen. At the booth, staff may read questions aloud and tap the answer the person says, never answering for them.
precheckRules.timeBudget: Timed on the booth build before the freeze and again on staging: a median pre-check of 2 minutes or less with no condition questions, and 4 minutes or less with condition questions, including SCI at T6 or above. If the pre-check runs over budget, the wording is shortened, never the item list.
precheckRules.fixedItems: Only the four stable setup items (pc_sci_level, pc_limb_arm_side, pc_limb_leg_side, pc_arm_pain_side) may move into the intake in phase 2, and only after the 2.1 data map, the privacy notice and the consent version are updated. Every other item stays in the pre-check whenever its condition applies.
precheckRules.everyTimeRule: These day of items are asked at every check they apply to, whatever the time budget.
precheckRules.review: Before the Oct 9 freeze the Arabic copywriter and Nasser review every question, Nasser first reviewing pc_sci_level, warn_sci_t6, scr_ad, the stop list and the fall screens. At the booth staff may keep a paper tally of question ids that visitors misread and how, with nothing about the person.
precheckRules.interactionStatus: O11b: recommended to Nasser as a Q18 (2) amendment; he ratifies it on the sign off page.

ask.ar: هل تشعر بتوعك اليوم؟ مثل الحمى، أو الزكام أو الإنفلونزا، أو عدوى، أو قيء، أو دوخة.
ask.en: Do you feel unwell today? For example a fever, a cold or flu, an infection, vomiting, or feeling dizzy or light headed.

proposal.why: Arabic seat: «دوخة» alone is the everyday Saudi word for feeling dizzy or light headed (test_stand_dizzy already pairs «بدوخة» with light headed), and it leaves the feeling of being about to faint to pc_urgent on the screen before, where it leads to emergency. It keeps the medical review rule (MR3): never «دوار». The English stays as it is.

alternatives: The reviewer’s «دوخة أو دوار خفيف»: against MR3, because «دوار» leans to vertigo and loses the feeling of being about to faint.
Keep the Q18 phrase in both lists and change the English of pc_unwell to Feeling dizzy or feeling that you might faint, so both languages show the same symptom twice; the routing stays as it is.

checkIn.decision: D-016 (Nasser, 2026-09-30): a simple check in, off by default. It replaces the council's check in, no response alarm and fall watch (O34, O42, Q31 (2) (4) (5) (6), R3C-01 to R3C-05).
checkIn.setting: An optional per device setting, «الاطمئنان عليك أثناء الاختبار» · Check on me during tests, off by default, in the coach settings only (simplicity cut C39 took the switch off the check intro, S14). At the booth it is off and not shown, because staff watch.
triggers: during a camera test, the person leaves the picture for 5 s
during a camera test, no movement for 10 s
checkIn.answers: The test pauses and the screen asks «هل أنت بخير؟» · Are you all right? «أنا بخير» · I am fine (the large button) goes on with the test: an attempt it paused is not counted and runs again after the rest before a repeat (60 s, a timed test 120 s and its one repeat); a timed test whose repeat is already used is not measured today. «أريد التوقف» · I want to stop opens the stop list (S41). The only press rule is a guard against a double tap.
checkIn.noAnswer: No answer within 30 s: one gentle chime (it follows the Sound setting), and the paused screen stays with the line of scr_no_response to call someone nearby. There is no alarm, no repeat and no escalation, and nothing is sent.
checkIn.off: When the setting is off there is no automatic check in: the STOP button, always on the camera screens, and the stop list are the way to stop.

stopRouting.resultOnStop: The stopped test stores no score. Results of tests finished earlier in the same check are kept, and a stop that ends the check closes it as ended early, stores nothing more that day and sets the lock shown.

rules.recent_change: next_day, releasableByClearance: released at once by a yes to pc_change_cleared (or yes_cleared in pc_sci_ad_since)
rules.sci_ready: none: allowed as soon as the person taps All of these are done

locks.record: { until, releasableByClearance } per user, without the reason id, deleted at expiry; guests: device storage only
locks.nextDay: ends at whichever comes later: midnight in the person’s time zone (Asia/Riyadh by default) or 8 hours after the lock started (Q33)
locks.minHoursBetweenChecks: 48 hours between completed checks (starting value, tuned in the pilot)
locks.tune: The 48 hour minimum, the next day locks and the 60 minute locks are starting values (tune in the pilot; Q33)
locks.api: A postponed check returns 409 POSTPONE with the reason in the response body only; a locked check returns 409 LOCKED with the time it ends. Reason ids never appear in URLs, query strings, server request logs or analytics events (Q25).

scr_emergency.ar: توقف الآن. ما تصفه قد يكون علامة على أنك تحتاج إلى مساعدة طبية عاجلة. اتصل بالرقم 997 لطلب الإسعاف. إذا كان معك أحد فأخبره. وإذا لم تستطع الكلام في الهاتف، فاطلب من أي شخص قريب أن يتصل عنك.
scr_emergency.arTts: تَوَقَّفِ الْآنْ. مَا تَصِفُهُ قَدْ يَكُونُ عَلَامَةً عَلَى أَنَّكَ تَحْتَاجُ إِلَى مُسَاعَدَةٍ طِبِّيَّةٍ عَاجِلَةْ. اِتَّصِلْ بِالرَّقْمْ، تِسْعَةْ، تِسْعَةْ، سَبْعَةْ، لِطَلَبِ الْإِسْعَافْ. إِذَا كَانَ مَعَكَ أَحَدٌ فَأَخْبِرْهْ. وَإِذَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِعِ الْكَلَامَ فِي الْهَاتِفْ، فَاطْلُبْ مِنْ أَيِّ شَخْصٍ قَرِيبٍ أَنْ يَتَّصِلَ عَنْكْ.
scr_emergency.en: Stop now. What you describe can be a sign that you need urgent medical help. Call 997 for an ambulance. If someone is with you, tell them. If you cannot speak on the phone, ask anyone nearby to call for you.

scr_ad.ar: قد تكون هذه علامات على خلل المنعكسات اللاإرادية، وهو ارتفاع مفاجئ في ضغط الدم بعد إصابة الحبل الشوكي. أوقف القياس الآن. اجلس مستقيمًا وساقاك إلى الأسفل، ولا تستلقِ. فُكّ أي شيء ضيق على جسمك. تحقق من المثانة وأنبوب القسطرة، ثم من الأمعاء والجلد. إذا كان لديك جهاز لقياس ضغط الدم، فقس ضغطك الآن ثم كل بضع دقائق. اتبع الخطة التي أعطاك إياها فريق رعايتك. إذا لم تزل العلامات بعد ذلك، أو لم تجد السبب، أو بقي ضغطك مرتفعًا، فاتصل بالرقم 997 وأخبرهم أن لديك إصابة في الحبل الشوكي وقد يكون لديك خلل المنعكسات اللاإرادية. أرِهم بطاقة خلل المنعكسات اللاإرادية إن كانت لديك. وإذا عادت العلامات لاحقًا اليوم، فاطلب المساعدة الطبية فورًا.
scr_ad.arTts: قَدْ تَكُونُ هَذِهِ عَلَامَاتٍ عَلَى خَلَلِ الْمُنْعَكَسَاتِ اللَّاإِرَادِيَّةْ، وَهُوَ ارْتِفَاعٌ مُفَاجِئٌ فِي ضَغْطِ الدَّمِ بَعْدَ إِصَابَةِ الْحَبْلِ الشَّوْكِيّ. أَوْقِفِ الْقِيَاسَ الْآنْ. اِجْلِسْ مُسْتَقِيمًا وَسَاقَاكَ إِلَى الْأَسْفَلْ، وَلَا تَسْتَلْقِ. فُكَّ أَيَّ شَيْءٍ ضَيِّقٍ عَلَى جِسْمِكْ. تَحَقَّقْ مِنَ الْمَثَانَةِ وَأُنْبُوبِ الْقَسْطَرَةْ، ثُمَّ مِنَ الْأَمْعَاءِ وَالْجِلْدْ. إِذَا كَانَ لَدَيْكَ جِهَازٌ لِقِيَاسِ ضَغْطِ الدَّمْ، فَقِسْ ضَغْطَكَ الْآنَ ثُمَّ كُلَّ بِضْعِ دَقَائِقْ. اِتَّبِعِ الْخُطَّةَ الَّتِي أَعْطَاكَ إِيَّاهَا فَرِيقُ رِعَايَتِكْ. إِذَا لَمْ تَزُلِ الْعَلَامَاتُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكْ، أَوْ لَمْ تَجِدِ السَّبَبْ، أَوْ بَقِيَ ضَغْطُكَ مُرْتَفِعًا، فَاتَّصِلْ بِالرَّقْمْ، تِسْعَةْ، تِسْعَةْ، سَبْعَةْ، وَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّ لَدَيْكَ إِصَابَةً فِي الْحَبْلِ الشَّوْكِيِّ وَقَدْ يَكُونُ لَدَيْكَ خَلَلُ الْمُنْعَكَسَاتِ اللَّاإِرَادِيَّةْ. أَرِهِمْ بِطَاقَةَ خَلَلِ الْمُنْعَكَسَاتِ اللَّاإِرَادِيَّةِ إِنْ كَانَتْ لَدَيْكْ. وَإِذَا عَادَتِ الْعَلَامَاتُ لَاحِقًا الْيَوْمْ، فَاطْلُبِ الْمُسَاعَدَةَ الطِّبِّيَّةَ فَوْرًا.
scr_ad.en: These can be signs of autonomic dysreflexia, a sudden rise in blood pressure after a spinal cord injury. Stop the check now. Sit upright with your legs down, and do not lie down. Loosen or undo anything tight on your body. Check your bladder and catheter tubing, then your bowel and skin. If you have a blood pressure monitor, check it now and every few minutes. Follow the plan from your care team. If the signs do not go away once you have done this, if you cannot find the cause, or if your blood pressure stays high, call 997 and tell them that you have a spinal cord injury and may have autonomic dysreflexia. Show your autonomic dysreflexia card if you have one. If the signs come back later today, get medical help straight away.

emergencyLead.ar: إذا كان لديك صداع نابض، أو احمرار أو تعرق فوق مستوى إصابتك، أو قشعريرة في الجلد، أو تشوش في الرؤية، أو انسداد في الأنف، فاتبع هذه الخطوات. أما إذا شعرت بأنك على وشك الإغماء دون هذه العلامات، فاستلقِ وارفع ساقيك إن استطعت.
emergencyLead.arTts: إِذَا كَانَ لَدَيْكَ صُدَاعٌ نَابِضْ، أَوِ احْمِرَارٌ أَوْ تَعَرُّقٌ فَوْقَ مُسْتَوَى إِصَابَتِكْ، أَوْ قُشَعْرِيرَةٌ فِي الْجِلْدْ، أَوْ تَشَوُّشٌ فِي الرُّؤْيَةْ، أَوِ انْسِدَادٌ فِي الْأَنْفْ، فَاتَّبِعْ هَذِهِ الْخُطُوَاتْ. أَمَّا إِذَا شَعَرْتَ بِأَنَّكَ عَلَى وَشْكِ الْإِغْمَاءِ دُونَ هَذِهِ الْعَلَامَاتْ، فَاسْتَلْقِ وَارْفَعْ سَاقَيْكَ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتْ.
emergencyLead.en: If you have a pounding headache, flushing or sweating above your injury, goosebumps, blurred vision or a stuffy nose, follow these steps. If you feel faint without these signs, lie down and raise your legs if you can.
emergencyLead.showOn: S36 only, and only when S36 is reached from pc_urgent: the AD card shown under scr_emergency for every SCI condition (pc_urgent alsoShowIf), right after the scr_emergency body, with this lead first. The other routes to S36 (ec_symptoms yes, the stop list chest or stroke_signs, sf_faint_loc yes or not sure) show no AD card and no lead: on the faint route the card would tell a person with SCI who has just fainted to sit upright right after scr_faint told them to lie down. If the medical seat wants the card on any of those routes, that action gains its own alsoShowIf, with this lead always first. Never on S37 (scr_ad reached from declared AD signs), where the signs are already known (O12 (3)). UX aligns the S36 row of check-ux-spec.md (scr_ad for SCI, alsoShow) with 2.7.
emergencyLead.status: pending: the medical seat confirms it before it is shown, and it joins Nasser’s Oct 9 review of scr_ad (Q18 (4)). If it is not approved by the freeze, booth staff briefed on the AD and orthostatic responses (2.7) cover the gap, and the home gate waits for it. It reuses phrases already approved in pc_sci_ad_now and scr_faint. The panel text (O12 (3)) left out «انسداد في الأنف» · a stuffy nose, which pc_sci_ad_now and warn_sci_t6 list; the data owner added it (review fixes, 2026-09-28), so a person with SCI who has a stuffy nose and feels faint is not sent to lie flat. The medical seat confirms the addition with the lead, or removes it and records why here.

scr_ad.cardOnFaintSci: On S38 for sci_t6, the scr_ad card follows scr_faint_sci under the heading «خطوات التعامل مع خلل المنعكسات اللاإرادية», collapsed to its heading and first sentence, opening on tap and spoken on Listen, so S38b is not delayed (O24-6). Because the card names the emergency number, S38 then carries the emergencyCall button as well (R-7, 2026-10-02); the 64 px number stays on scr_emergency only.

scr_faint.ar: إذا كنت واقفًا، فاجلس الآن. وإذا بقي لديك شعور بأنك على وشك الإغماء، فاستلقِ وارفع ساقيك إن استطعت. وإذا لم يزل هذا الشعور، أو شعرت بألم في الصدر، فاطلب المساعدة الطبية فورًا.
scr_faint.arTts: إِذَا كُنْتَ وَاقِفًا، فَاجْلِسِ الْآنْ. وَإِذَا بَقِيَ لَدَيْكَ شُعُورٌ بِأَنَّكَ عَلَى وَشْكِ الْإِغْمَاءْ، فَاسْتَلْقِ وَارْفَعْ سَاقَيْكَ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتْ. وَإِذَا لَمْ يَزُلْ هَذَا الشُّعُورْ، أَوْ شَعَرْتَ بِأَلَمٍ فِي الصَّدْرْ، فَاطْلُبِ الْمُسَاعَدَةَ الطِّبِّيَّةَ فَوْرًا.
scr_faint.en: If you are standing, sit down now. If you still feel faint, lie down and raise your legs if you can. If it does not pass, or you have chest pain, get medical help straight away.

scr_faint_sci.ar: إذا كان لديك أيضًا صداع نابض، فاجلس مستقيمًا بدلًا من ذلك، واتبع خطوات التعامل مع خلل المنعكسات اللاإرادية.
scr_faint_sci.arTts: إِذَا كَانَ لَدَيْكَ أَيْضًا صُدَاعٌ نَابِضْ، فَاجْلِسْ مُسْتَقِيمًا بَدَلًا مِنْ ذَلِكْ، وَاتَّبِعْ خُطُوَاتِ التَّعَامُلِ مَعَ خَلَلِ الْمُنْعَكَسَاتِ اللَّاإِرَادِيَّةْ.
scr_faint_sci.en: If you also have a pounding headache, sit upright instead and follow the steps for dealing with autonomic dysreflexia.

scr_fall.ar: ابقَ ساكنًا لحظة، وتأكد هل أصابك أذى. إذا اصطدم رأسك بشيء، أو كنت تنزف، أو شعرت بألم جديد، أو لم تستطع النهوض، فلا تحاول الوقوف، واطلب المساعدة بصوت عالٍ. وإذا لم تُصب، فانقلب على جانبك، ثم ارتكز على يديك وركبتيك، ثم تحرك نحو كرسي متين، واستند إليه لتنهض ببطء. استرح قبل أن تقف.
scr_fall.arTts: اِبْقَ سَاكِنًا لَحْظَةْ، وَتَأَكَّدْ هَلْ أَصَابَكَ أَذَى. إِذَا اصْطَدَمَ رَأْسُكَ بِشَيْءْ، أَوْ كُنْتَ تَنْزِفْ، أَوْ شَعَرْتَ بِأَلَمٍ جَدِيدْ، أَوْ لَمْ تَسْتَطِعِ النُّهُوضْ، فَلَا تُحَاوِلِ الْوُقُوفْ، وَاطْلُبِ الْمُسَاعَدَةَ بِصَوْتٍ عَالْ. وَإِذَا لَمْ تُصَبْ، فَانْقَلِبْ عَلَى جَانِبِكْ، ثُمَّ ارْتَكِزْ عَلَى يَدَيْكَ وَرُكْبَتَيْكْ، ثُمَّ تَحَرَّكْ نَحْوَ كُرْسِيٍّ مَتِينْ، وَاسْتَنِدْ إِلَيْهِ لِتَنْهَضَ بِبُطْءْ. اِسْتَرِحْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقِفْ.
scr_fall.en: Stay still for a moment and check whether you are hurt. If you hit your head, are bleeding, have new pain, or cannot get up, do not try to stand. Call out for help. If you are not hurt, roll onto your side, get onto your hands and knees, then move to a sturdy chair and lean on it to push up slowly. Rest before you stand.

scr_fall_seated.ar: ابقَ ساكنًا لحظة، وتأكد هل أصابك أذى. إذا اصطدم رأسك بشيء، أو كنت تنزف، أو شعرت بألم جديد، فاطلب المساعدة بصوت عالٍ. لا تحاول العودة إلى كرسيك وحدك إلا إذا تعلمت طريقة آمنة لذلك. اطلب من أحد أن يساعدك، وحافظ على دفئك وأنت تنتظر.
scr_fall_seated.arTts: اِبْقَ سَاكِنًا لَحْظَةْ، وَتَأَكَّدْ هَلْ أَصَابَكَ أَذَى. إِذَا اصْطَدَمَ رَأْسُكَ بِشَيْءْ، أَوْ كُنْتَ تَنْزِفْ، أَوْ شَعَرْتَ بِأَلَمٍ جَدِيدْ، فَاطْلُبِ الْمُسَاعَدَةَ بِصَوْتٍ عَالْ. لَا تُحَاوِلِ الْعَوْدَةَ إِلَى كُرْسِيِّكَ وَحْدَكَ إِلَّا إِذَا تَعَلَّمْتَ طَرِيقَةً آمِنَةً لِذَلِكْ. اُطْلُبْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ أَنْ يُسَاعِدَكْ، وَحَافِظْ عَلَى دِفْئِكَ وَأَنْتَ تَنْتَظِرْ.
scr_fall_seated.en: Stay still for a moment and check whether you are hurt. If you hit your head, are bleeding or have new pain, call out for help. Do not try to get back into your chair alone unless you have learned a safe way to do it. Call someone to help you, and keep warm while you wait.

scr_no_response.ar: إذا احتجت إلى مساعدة وكان بالقرب منك أحد، فنادِه الآن.
scr_no_response.arTts: إِذَا احْتَجْتَ إِلَى مُسَاعَدَةٍ وَكَانَ بِالْقُرْبِ مِنْكَ أَحَدْ، فَنَادِهِ الْآنْ.
scr_no_response.en: If you need help and anyone is near you, call out to them now.

scr_stop_seek_care.ar: لنتوقف هنا. استرح في وضع مريح. إذا لم يهدأ ما تشعر به أو أقلقك، فتواصل مع طبيبك أو فريق رعايتك. وإذا لم يكن لديك طبيب تسأله، فيمكنك الاتصال بوزارة الصحة على الرقم 937 للاستشارة. وإذا اشتد ما تشعر به، فاطلب المساعدة الطبية فورًا.
scr_stop_seek_care.arTts: لِنَتَوَقَّفْ هُنَا. اِسْتَرِحْ فِي وَضْعٍ مُرِيحْ. إِذَا لَمْ يَهْدَأْ مَا تَشْعُرُ بِهِ أَوْ أَقْلَقَكْ، فَتَوَاصَلْ مَعَ طَبِيبِكَ أَوْ فَرِيقِ رِعَايَتِكْ. وَإِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَدَيْكَ طَبِيبٌ تَسْأَلُهْ، فَيُمْكِنُكَ الِاتِّصَالُ بِوِزَارَةِ الصِّحَّةِ عَلَى الرَّقْمْ، تِسْعَةْ، ثَلَاثَةْ، سَبْعَةْ، لِلِاسْتِشَارَةْ. وَإِذَا اشْتَدَّ مَا تَشْعُرُ بِهْ، فَاطْلُبِ الْمُسَاعَدَةَ الطِّبِّيَّةَ فَوْرًا.
scr_stop_seek_care.en: Let’s stop here. Rest in a comfortable position. If what you feel does not settle, or it worries you, contact your doctor or care team. If you do not have a doctor to ask, you can call the Ministry of Health on 937 for advice. If it becomes severe, get medical help straight away.

scr_stop_pain.ar: لنتوقف هنا ونكمل في يوم آخر. استرح، وإذا لم يهدأ الألم، فراجع طبيبك أو فريق رعايتك.
scr_stop_pain.arTts: لِنَتَوَقَّفْ هُنَا وَنُكْمِلْ فِي يَوْمٍ آخَرْ. اِسْتَرِحْ، وَإِذَا لَمْ يَهْدَأِ الْأَلَمْ، فَرَاجِعْ طَبِيبَكَ أَوْ فَرِيقَ رِعَايَتِكْ.
scr_stop_pain.en: Let’s stop here and continue on another day. Rest, and if the pain does not settle, check with your doctor or care team.

scr_postpone_care.ar: لنؤجل قياس الحركة اليوم. هذا ليس تشخيصًا، بل تأجيل حرصًا على سلامتك. يرجى مراجعة طبيبك أو فريق رعايتك قبل القياس القادم. وإذا لم يكن لديك طبيب تسأله، فيمكنك الاتصال بوزارة الصحة على الرقم 937 للاستشارة.
scr_postpone_care.arTts: لِنُؤَجِّلْ قِيَاسَ الْحَرَكَةِ الْيَوْمْ. هَذَا لَيْسَ تَشْخِيصًا، بَلْ تَأْجِيلٌ حِرْصًا عَلَى سَلَامَتِكْ. يُرْجَى مُرَاجَعَةُ طَبِيبِكَ أَوْ فَرِيقِ رِعَايَتِكَ قَبْلَ الْقِيَاسِ الْقَادِمْ. وَإِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَدَيْكَ طَبِيبٌ تَسْأَلُهْ، فَيُمْكِنُكَ الِاتِّصَالُ بِوِزَارَةِ الصِّحَّةِ عَلَى الرَّقْمْ، تِسْعَةْ، ثَلَاثَةْ، سَبْعَةْ، لِلِاسْتِشَارَةْ.
scr_postpone_care.en: Let’s pause today’s movement check. This is not a diagnosis, just a safety pause. Please check with your doctor or care team before your next check. If you do not have a doctor to ask, you can call the Ministry of Health on 937 for advice.

scr_postpone_unwell.ar: لنُجرِ القياس في يوم تشعر فيه أنك بخير.
scr_postpone_unwell.arTts: لِنُجْرِ الْقِيَاسَ فِي يَوْمٍ تَشْعُرُ فِيهِ أَنَّكَ بِخَيْرْ.
scr_postpone_unwell.en: Let’s do the check on a day when you feel well.

scr_postpone_pain.ar: ألمك مرتفع اليوم. لنُجرِ القياس في يوم آخر. إذا لم يهدأ الألم، فراجع طبيبك أو فريق رعايتك.
scr_postpone_pain.arTts: أَلَمُكَ مُرْتَفِعٌ الْيَوْمْ. لِنُجْرِ الْقِيَاسَ فِي يَوْمٍ آخَرْ. إِذَا لَمْ يَهْدَأِ الْأَلَمْ، فَرَاجِعْ طَبِيبَكَ أَوْ فَرِيقَ رِعَايَتِكْ.
scr_postpone_pain.en: Your pain is high today. Let’s do the check on another day. If the pain does not settle, check with your doctor or care team.

scr_postpone_cool.ar: لنُجرِ القياس لاحقًا. إذا كنت تشعر بالحر، فبرّد جسمك واسترح أولًا، ثم حاول مجددًا في غرفة باردة بعد ساعة على الأقل. وإذا بقيت أعراضك أسوأ من المعتاد بعد يوم، أو أصابتك حمى، فتواصل مع طبيبك أو فريق رعايتك.
scr_postpone_cool.arTts: لِنُجْرِ الْقِيَاسَ لَاحِقًا. إِذَا كُنْتَ تَشْعُرُ بِالْحَرّ، فَبَرِّدْ جِسْمَكَ وَاسْتَرِحْ أَوَّلًا، ثُمَّ حَاوِلْ مُجَدَّدًا فِي غُرْفَةٍ بَارِدَةٍ بَعْدَ سَاعَةٍ عَلَى الْأَقَلّ. وَإِذَا بَقِيَتْ أَعْرَاضُكَ أَسْوَأَ مِنَ الْمُعْتَادِ بَعْدَ يَوْمْ، أَوْ أَصَابَتْكَ حُمَّى، فَتَوَاصَلْ مَعَ طَبِيبِكَ أَوْ فَرِيقِ رِعَايَتِكْ.
scr_postpone_cool.en: Let’s do the check later. If you feel hot, cool down and rest first, then try again in a cool room after at least an hour. If your symptoms are still worse than usual after a day, or you have a fever, contact your doctor or care team.

scr_postpone_pd.ar: لنُجرِ القياس في وقت يعمل فيه دواؤك بشكل جيد.
scr_postpone_pd.arTts: لِنُجْرِ الْقِيَاسَ فِي وَقْتٍ يَعْمَلُ فِيهِ دَوَاؤُكَ بِشَكْلٍ جَيِّدْ.
scr_postpone_pd.en: Let’s do the check at a time when your medicine is working well.

scr_postpone_sci.ar: يرجى الاهتمام بهذه الأمور أولًا، ثم عُد إلى القياس.
scr_postpone_sci.arTts: يُرْجَى الِاهْتِمَامُ بِهَذِهِ الْأُمُورِ أَوَّلًا، ثُمَّ عُدْ إِلَى الْقِيَاسْ.
scr_postpone_sci.en: Please take care of these first, then come back to the check.

scr_paused_today.ar: أُجِّل قياس اليوم حرصًا على سلامتك. يمكنك المحاولة مجددًا {when}.
scr_paused_today.arTts: أُجِّلَ قِيَاسُ الْيَوْمِ حِرْصًا عَلَى سَلَامَتِكْ.
scr_paused_today.en: Today’s check has been postponed for your safety. You can try again {when}.
scr_paused_today.arTtsScope: First sentence only (O24-2): the {when} sentence is display only and read by screen readers, so the voice never speaks a clock time. The sentence count lint (7.2-12) checks the first sentence only.

scr_note_care.ar: سنتخطى هذا الاختبار اليوم. يرجى إخبار طبيبك أو فريق رعايتك بشأن القرحة.
scr_note_care.arTts: سَنَتَخَطَّى هَذَا الِاخْتِبَارَ الْيَوْمْ. يُرْجَى إِخْبَارُ طَبِيبِكَ أَوْ فَرِيقِ رِعَايَتِكَ بِشَأْنِ الْقُرْحَةْ.
scr_note_care.en: We will skip this test today. Please let your doctor or care team know about the sore.

scr_after_lasting.ar: شكرًا لإخبارنا. إذا استمر الألم أو التعب، فراجع طبيبك أو فريق رعايتك قبل جلستك القادمة. وإذا لم يكن لديك طبيب تسأله، فيمكنك الاتصال بوزارة الصحة على الرقم 937 للاستشارة.
scr_after_lasting.arTts: شُكْرًا لِإِخْبَارِنَا. إِذَا اسْتَمَرَّ الْأَلَمُ أَوِ التَّعَبْ، فَرَاجِعْ طَبِيبَكَ أَوْ فَرِيقَ رِعَايَتِكَ قَبْلَ جَلْسَتِكَ الْقَادِمَةْ. وَإِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَدَيْكَ طَبِيبٌ تَسْأَلُهْ، فَيُمْكِنُكَ الِاتِّصَالُ بِوِزَارَةِ الصِّحَّةِ عَلَى الرَّقْمْ، تِسْعَةْ، ثَلَاثَةْ، سَبْعَةْ، لِلِاسْتِشَارَةْ.
scr_after_lasting.en: Thank you for telling us. If the pain or tiredness continues, check with your doctor or care team before your next session. If you do not have a doctor to ask, you can call the Ministry of Health on 937 for advice.

scr_helper_brief_stand.ar: قف قريبًا بجانبه في جهته الأضعف، خلفه قليلًا. أبقِ يديك قريبتين من خصره دون أن تلمسه. إذا فقد توازنه، فثبّته من الخصر أو الوركين، ولا تمسكه من ذراعه أبدًا، وساعده على الجلوس. لا بأس أن تظهر في الصورة، لكن لا تقف بينه وبين الهاتف. لا يُسجَّل الفيديو ولا يُرسَل، ولا نحفظ أي شيء عنك.
scr_helper_brief_stand.en: Stand close beside them on their weaker side, slightly behind. Keep your hands near their waist without touching. If they lose balance, steady them at the waist or hips, never by the arm, and help them sit down. You may be in the picture, but do not stand between them and the phone. The video is not recorded or sent, and nothing about you is saved.
scr_helper_brief_stand.arTts: قِفْ قَرِيبًا بِجَانِبِهِ فِي جِهَتِهِ الْأَضْعَفْ، خَلْفَهُ قَلِيلًا. أَبْقِ يَدَيْكَ قَرِيبَتَيْنِ مِنْ خَصْرِهِ دُونَ أَنْ تَلْمِسَهْ. إِذَا فَقَدَ تَوَازُنَهْ، فَثَبِّتْهُ مِنَ الْخَصْرِ أَوِ الْوَرِكَيْنْ، وَلَا تُمْسِكْهُ مِنْ ذِرَاعِهِ أَبَدًا، وَسَاعِدْهُ عَلَى الْجُلُوسْ. لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ تَظْهَرَ فِي الصُّورَةْ، لَكِنْ لَا تَقِفْ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْهَاتِفْ. لَا يُسَجَّلُ الْفِيدْيُو وَلَا يُرْسَلْ، وَلَا نَحْفَظُ أَيَّ شَيْءٍ عَنْكْ.

scr_helper_brief_trunk.ar: اجلس أو قف قريبًا بجانبه في جهته الأضعف، خلفه قليلًا. أبقِ يديك قريبتين من كتفه دون أن تلمسه. إذا بدأ يميل أكثر مما يستطيع التحكم فيه، فثبّته من الكتف أو الجذع، ولا تمسكه من ذراعه أبدًا، وساعده على العودة إلى الجلوس المستقيم. لا بأس أن تظهر في الصورة، لكن لا تقف بينه وبين الهاتف. لا يُسجَّل الفيديو ولا يُرسَل، ولا نحفظ أي شيء عنك.
scr_helper_brief_trunk.en: Sit or stand close beside them on their weaker side, slightly behind. Keep your hands near their shoulder without touching. If they start to tip further than they can manage, steady them at the shoulder or trunk, never by the arm, and help them sit upright again. You may be in the picture, but do not stand between them and the phone. The video is not recorded or sent, and nothing about you is saved.
scr_helper_brief_trunk.arTts: اِجْلِسْ أَوْ قِفْ قَرِيبًا بِجَانِبِهِ فِي جِهَتِهِ الْأَضْعَفْ، خَلْفَهُ قَلِيلًا. أَبْقِ يَدَيْكَ قَرِيبَتَيْنِ مِنْ كَتِفِهِ دُونَ أَنْ تَلْمِسَهْ. إِذَا بَدَأَ يَمِيلُ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا يَسْتَطِيعُ التَّحَكُّمَ فِيهْ، فَثَبِّتْهُ مِنَ الْكَتِفِ أَوِ الْجِذْعْ، وَلَا تُمْسِكْهُ مِنْ ذِرَاعِهِ أَبَدًا، وَسَاعِدْهُ عَلَى الْعَوْدَةِ إِلَى الْجُلُوسِ الْمُسْتَقِيمْ. لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ تَظْهَرَ فِي الصُّورَةْ، لَكِنْ لَا تَقِفْ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْهَاتِفْ. لَا يُسَجَّلُ الْفِيدْيُو وَلَا يُرْسَلْ، وَلَا نَحْفَظُ أَيَّ شَيْءٍ عَنْكْ.

warn_sci_t6.ar: قد تكون إصابتك عند المستوى T6 أو أعلى. إذا شعرت بصداع نابض، أو تعرق أو احمرار فوق مستوى إصابتك، أو قشعريرة في الجلد، أو تشوش في الرؤية، أو انسداد في الأنف، فتوقف واجلس مستقيمًا. ثم اتبع خطة فريق رعايتك، واطلب المساعدة الطبية فورًا إذا لم تهدأ الأعراض سريعًا.
warn_sci_t6.arTts: قَدْ تَكُونُ إِصَابَتُكَ عِنْدَ الْمُسْتَوَى تِي سِتَّةْ أَوْ أَعْلَى. إِذَا شَعَرْتَ بِصُدَاعٍ نَابِضْ، أَوْ تَعَرُّقٍ أَوِ احْمِرَارٍ فَوْقَ مُسْتَوَى إِصَابَتِكْ، أَوْ قُشَعْرِيرَةٍ فِي الْجِلْدْ، أَوْ تَشَوُّشٍ فِي الرُّؤْيَةْ، أَوِ انْسِدَادٍ فِي الْأَنْفْ، فَتَوَقَّفْ وَاجْلِسْ مُسْتَقِيمًا. ثُمَّ اتَّبِعْ خُطَّةَ فَرِيقِ رِعَايَتِكْ، وَاطْلُبِ الْمُسَاعَدَةَ الطِّبِّيَّةَ فَوْرًا إِذَا لَمْ تَهْدَأِ الْأَعْرَاضُ سَرِيعًا.
warn_sci_t6.en: Your injury may be at T6 or higher. If you get a pounding headache, sweating or flushing above your injury, goosebumps, blurred vision or a stuffy nose, stop and sit upright. Then follow your care team’s plan, and get medical help straight away if it does not settle quickly.

warn_pain_high.ar: ألمك مرتفع اليوم. تحرك بهدوء، وتوقف إذا زاد الألم.
warn_pain_high.arTts: أَلَمُكَ مُرْتَفِعٌ الْيَوْمْ. تَحَرَّكْ بِهُدُوءْ، وَتَوَقَّفْ إِذَا زَادَ الْأَلَمْ.
warn_pain_high.en: Your pain is high today. Go gently, and stop if your pain rises.

warn_weak_shoulder.ar: احمِ كتفك الأضعف. عندما ترتاح، أسند تلك الذراع على فخذك أو على مسند الذراع، ولا تشدّها أبدًا، ولا تدع أحدًا يسحبك منها.
warn_weak_shoulder.arTts: اِحْمِ كَتِفَكَ الْأَضْعَفْ. عِنْدَمَا تَرْتَاحْ، أَسْنِدْ تِلْكَ الذِّرَاعَ عَلَى فَخِذِكَ أَوْ عَلَى مِسْنَدِ الذِّرَاعْ، وَلَا تَشُدَّهَا أَبَدًا، وَلَا تَدَعْ أَحَدًا يَسْحَبُكَ مِنْهَا.
warn_weak_shoulder.en: Protect your weaker shoulder. When you rest, support that arm on your lap or an armrest, and never pull on it or let anyone pull you up by it.

warn_ms_cool.ar: اختر غرفة باردة، وإن أمكن وقتًا من اليوم قريبًا من وقت قياسك الأخير.
warn_ms_cool.arTts: اِخْتَرْ غُرْفَةً بَارِدَةْ، وَإِنْ أَمْكَنَ وَقْتًا مِنَ الْيَوْمِ قَرِيبًا مِنْ وَقْتِ قِيَاسِكَ الْأَخِيرْ.
warn_ms_cool.en: Use a cool room and, if you can, a similar time of day as your last check.

warn_pd_timing.ar: في المرة الماضية أجريت القياس بعد دوائك {x}. والقياس في توقيت مشابه يساعد على المقارنة.
warn_pd_timing.arTts: فِي الْمَرَّةِ الْمَاضِيَةِ أَجْرَيْتَ الْقِيَاسَ بَعْدَ دَوَائِكَ {x}. وَالْقِيَاسُ فِي تَوْقِيتٍ مُشَابِهٍ يُسَاعِدُ عَلَى الْمُقَارَنَةْ.
warn_pd_timing.en: Last time you did the check {x} after your medicine. Checking at a similar time helps the comparison.
warn_pd_timing.arTtsTokens: precheck.pc_pd_dose.timingTokens.<bucket>.arTts fills {x}; the token ends the sentence, so it is in pausal form.

scr_booth_no_check.ar: حرصًا على سلامتك، لا نجري قياس الحركة اليوم مع حالتك الطبية. تحدث مع أحد أفراد فريقنا في الجناح، ويسعده أن يريك كيف يعمل عزم.
scr_booth_no_check.arTts: حِرْصًا عَلَى سَلَامَتِكْ، لَا نُجْرِي قِيَاسَ الْحَرَكَةِ الْيَوْمَ مَعَ حَالَتِكَ الطِّبِّيَّةْ. تَحَدَّثْ مَعَ أَحَدِ أَفْرَادِ فَرِيقِنَا فِي الْجَنَاحْ، وَيُسْعِدُهُ أَنْ يُرِيَكَ كَيْفَ يَعْمَلُ عَزْمْ.
scr_booth_no_check.en: For your safety, we will not run the movement check today with your medical condition. Please talk with one of our team at the booth, who will be glad to show you how Azm works.

scr_sound_off.ar: ارفع صوت الهاتف وأوقف الوضع الصامت، ثم حاول مجددًا.
scr_sound_off.arTts: اِرْفَعْ صَوْتَ الْهَاتِفِ وَأَوْقِفِ الْوَضْعَ الصَّامِتْ، ثُمَّ حَاوِلْ مُجَدَّدًا.
scr_sound_off.en: Turn up the volume and switch off silent mode, then try again.

scr_sound_still_off.ar: إذا بقي الصوت مغلقًا، فلن تسمع التعليمات الصوتية ولا صوت التنبيه، لذلك يُفضَّل أن يكون معك شخص بالغ.
scr_sound_still_off.arTts: إِذَا بَقِيَ الصَّوْتُ مُغْلَقًا، فَلَنْ تَسْمَعَ التَّعْلِيمَاتِ الصَّوْتِيَّةَ وَلَا صَوْتَ التَّنْبِيهْ، لِذَلِكَ يُفَضَّلُ أَنْ يَكُونَ مَعَكَ شَخْصٌ بَالِغْ.
scr_sound_still_off.en: If the sound stays off, you will not hear the spoken instructions or the alert tone, so it is better to have another adult with you.

scr_early_start.ar: تتغير النتائج من يوم إلى آخر، لذلك تكون المقارنة أوضح عندما تقيس كل أربعة أسابيع تقريبًا. هل تريد أن تبدأ الآن؟
scr_early_start.arTts: تَتَغَيَّرُ النَّتَائِجُ مِنْ يَوْمٍ إِلَى آخَرْ، لِذَلِكَ تَكُونُ الْمُقَارَنَةُ أَوْضَحَ عِنْدَمَا تَقِيسُ كُلَّ أَرْبَعَةِ أَسَابِيعَ تَقْرِيبًا. هَلْ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَبْدَأَ الْآنْ؟
scr_early_start.en: Results change from day to day, so the comparison is clearer when you check about every 4 weeks. Do you want to start now?

helperBriefing.voice: Read aloud by the voice with the fully vocalised speech lines written by the Arabic seat in the Arabic copy pass (screens.scr_helper_brief_stand.arTts and screens.scr_helper_brief_trunk.arTts).
helperBriefing.picture: The top down picture from P4 (chair stand setup), with the helper's place marked: the weaker side, slightly behind; for the side lean the same layout around the chair.
helperBriefing.steadyRule: Steady at the waist or hips (chair stand) or the shoulder or trunk (side lean), never by the arm.
helperBriefing.closing: Both briefings end with the sentence: You may be in the picture, but do not stand between them and the phone. The video is not recorded or sent, and nothing about you is saved.

confirmButton.en: My helper is beside me and has read this

helperBriefing.startGate: The test starts only after the tap on confirmButton.
helperBriefing.pronouns: Phase 2 (Q24): when the feminine address is chosen, the pronouns switch to match (بجانبه / بجانبها; بينه / بينها).

emergencyCall.firstActionOn: the two emergency screens, which are the only screens that name 997 (scr_emergency, and scr_ad for autonomic dysreflexia; D-016): the first action is this full width button. The scr_ad card brings it wherever it shows, S38 for sci_t6 included (cardOnFaintSci).
emergencyCall.bigNumberRule: The number is also shown as text at least 64 px tall, so it can be read from 2 to 3 m or from the floor and dialled from another phone when this device cannot call (laptops, tablets).
emergencyCall.numbers: 997 for emergencies and 937 for non urgent advice only. 911 appears on no user screen until region wide ambulance dispatch through 911 is confirmed; the 911 region list is re-verified before the booth. tel: links never dial by themselves. Digits follow D-036 item 3 (997 and 937 in Western digits in Arabic text too, tel:997 and tel:937 in the href); the voice reads the number digit by digit.

min60_start.when: 60 minute lock, shown when the lock starts

min60_active.when: 60 minute lock, the person returns while it is active

nextDay_midnight.when: next day lock that ends at midnight

nextDay_clock.when: next day lock that ends at a clock time tomorrow (8 hours after it started)

sameDay_clock.when: the person returns on the day the lock ends

restriction_overhead.ar: تخطينا هذا الاختبار لأنك أخبرتنا أن عليك تجنب رفع ذراعيك فوق مستوى الكتف.
restriction_overhead.en: Skipped because you told us you need to avoid lifting your arms above shoulder height.

restriction_weight_bearing.ar: تخطينا هذا الاختبار لأنك أخبرتنا أن عليك تجنب تحميل وزنك على ساقيك.
restriction_weight_bearing.en: Skipped because you told us you need to avoid putting weight on your legs.

restriction_balance.ar: تخطينا هذا الاختبار لأنك أخبرتنا أنك تحتاج إلى سند للحفاظ على توازنك.
restriction_balance.en: Skipped because you told us you need support for your balance.

pain_area.ar: تخطينا هذا الاختبار بسبب الألم في هذه المنطقة.
pain_area.en: Skipped because of pain in this area.

pain_today.ar: تخطينا هذا الاختبار اليوم لأن ألم هذه المنطقة مرتفع.
pain_today.en: Skipped today because pain in this area is high.

pain_more.ar: تخطينا هذا الاختبار اليوم لأن هذه المنطقة تؤلمك اليوم أكثر.
pain_more.en: Skipped today because this area hurts more today.

flare.ar: تخطينا هذا الاختبار اليوم لأن أحد المفاصل التي يعتمد عليها في نوبة التهاب.
flare.en: Skipped today because a joint used in this test is in a flare.

limb_loss_arm.en: We measure your other arm only.

limb_loss_leg.ar: هذا الاختبار غير متاح في هذه النسخة لمن فقدوا ساقًا أو جزءًا منها، ونستخدم بدلًا منه اختبار الميل الجانبي أثناء الجلوس.
limb_loss_leg.en: This test is not offered in this version for people with leg limb loss. We use the seated side lean instead.

position_seated.ar: هذا الاختبار لمن يقفون، لذلك نستخدم بدلًا منه اختبار الميل الجانبي أثناء الجلوس.

Replaces quality for that case (UX B17, O33 (6)). A device with no orientation sensor never starts camera tests (S04, O10). A same day skip: no substitute is added.

ask.en: Are you sitting now on a firm chair without wheels, about knee height, like the one in the picture, with something sturdy within reach in front of you?

setupQuestions.screen: The chair stand setup screen, from the second check of a series.

metric.definition: 2D angle in pixel space (D-003) between the upper arm vector (shoulder 11 or 12 to elbow 13 or 14) and the downward trunk axis (mid shoulder to mid hip). 0 is arm at the side, 180 is straight overhead. Clamp 0 to 180. An arm that passes the vertical toward the head is clamped at 180 and flagged pastVertical; it is not folded back.
metric.fallback: Trunk reference whenever the hips were visible at calibration: the mid hip is then fixed at its median position in the calibration frames (as in 4.3), so hips hidden later by armrests or a lap tray do not matter. Gravity reference only when the hips were never visible at calibration: the vertical comes from the phone orientation sensor, and the measured phone roll is stored per attempt and subtracted. With no orientation reading, gravity mode is not allowed: not measured today (motion_needed when the phone’s motion permission was refused, O33 (6); a device with no orientation sensor never starts camera tests, O10). Lean in gravity mode = mid shoulder sideways shift from calibration divided by shoulder width: cue above 0.08, invalid above 0.15 (tune at booth). A person keeps one reference type per series.
metric.planeCheck: Runs over the whole ascent, not at the peak. An attempt is valid only if, in the frames where the 2D angle is between 70 and 110 degrees, the upper arm pixel length is at least 0.85 of the reference length for at least 0.3 s. If the 2D angle goes from below 60 to above 120 degrees without such frames, the attempt is invalid (reason plane_flexion) and the cue test_abd_side plays. Reference length = the larger of the hanging calibration length and the longest upper arm length seen between 70 and 110 degrees in the practice lift. Elbow z minus shoulder z at the peak (MediaPipe relative z) is stored as detail.planeZ for booth calibration only and is never used in the angle.
metric.attemptValue: Highest angle held for at least 0.5 s: the maximum over time of the rolling 0.5 s window minimum of the angle.

tests.calibration: Arms relaxed at the sides for at least 1 s before the first attempt of each check: trunk axis (and the fixed mid hip when hips are visible), shoulder width, ear to shoulder distances and each upper arm pixel length.

validity.boothFallback: Council F-1 (outcome W) and D-016 item 4: at the booth only, staff may switch the plane check to upperArmLengthMinRatioBoothFallback in place of upperArmLengthMinRatio (booth staff settings, off by default, never at home). The ratio that measured is stored with each arm raise result as detail.planeRatio. 0.75 is the floor F-1 set; the plane check never uses a lower ratio.
validity.shrug: coaching and logging only (ear to shoulder distance / resting shoulder width)
validity.configurable: Every threshold here is a configurable constant, kept for the retune before home checks open (Q14).
validity.verification: Before the Oct 9 freeze: a goniometer bench check on team members only (Nasser measures, including deliberate forward flexion plane lifts meant to trigger the plane check; the tech lead records any misfire). Recorded in the design file as engineering verification, never presented as validation. Retuned before home checks open from the bench check and the booth safety system tally (arm raise flags that fired on a lift staff judged clean, or stayed silent on an obvious compensation). The goniometer subset with people living with disabilities waits for ethics approval (Q2, Q14).

wideWhen: conditions include stroke, ms, cerebral_palsy, sci_complete, sci_incomplete or parkinsons
this side is the declared weaker side
either check has attempt spread over 15 degrees, gravity reference or bent elbow
noVerdictWhen: shoulder pain on this side (setup.painSides): show start and now with the sentence noVerdict.shoulderPain on a normal result card, never a greyed or error state, until Azm has its own MDC (P1, Q1)
fewer than 2 valid attempts on that side at either check (noVerdict.oneValid)
poseModel differs between baseline and now: not comparable
noiseBandRules.agreement: higher or lower only when both the best and the median of valid attempts differ from baseline by more than the band, in the same direction

sideRules: Side with arm limb loss: not measured (v1 measures the other side only, never a residual limb, with or without a prosthesis).
Weaker side: stronger side first; weaker side uses the wide band; pc_weak_lift no or pc_weak_shoulder yes skips it.
Shoulder pain side (setup.painSides): pain free range; values shown without a verdict; today score 6 skips that side.
Bent elbow is accepted and recorded when spasticity or tetraplegia requires it (stroke, cerebral_palsy, sci). Keep it the same at later checks.

Booth, stroke or SCI with clearance no or not sure: this is the only test run, seated, active movement only, without load, with all its rules (pc_weak_lift, pc_weak_shoulder, thumb up) and staff within arm's reach (Q19).

phone stand or a place to prop the phone upright
equipment.consistency: Same chair type and backrest, same wheelchair set up (tilt, cushion), same reference type.

other: fitted or folded sleeves so the elbow shows
one person in the chair; a helper may be in the picture at the side, never between the phone and the person, and never touching

stopRules.route: stroke_signs when sudden and it does not settle on lowering the arm, otherwise other

stopRules.route: the person chooses on the stop list

purpose.ar: يُظهر إلى أي ارتفاع ترفع كل ذراع إلى الجانب ضمن المدى المريح لك.
purpose.en: Shows how high you raise each arm out to the side, within a comfortable range.

ar: اجلس مستقيمًا على كرسي ثابت له ظهر، وظهرك مستند إليه. إذا كنت تستخدم كرسيًا متحركًا، فابقَ عليه وفرامله مقفلة.
ضع الهاتف أمامك على بعد مترين إلى ثلاثة أمتار، بارتفاع صدرك تقريبًا، وواجهه.
ارفع ذراعك ببطء إلى الجانب، إلى أعلى ارتفاع مريح لك.
en: Sit tall on a steady chair with a backrest, your back resting against it. If you use a wheelchair, stay in it with the brakes on.
Place the phone in front of you, 2 to 3 meters away, at about chest height, and face it.
Slowly raise your arm out to the side, as high as is comfortable for you.
arTts: اِجْلِسْ مُسْتَقِيمًا عَلَى كُرْسِيٍّ ثَابِتٍ لَهُ ظَهْرْ، وَظَهْرُكَ مُسْتَنِدٌ إِلَيْهْ. إِذَا كُنْتَ تَسْتَخْدِمُ كُرْسِيًّا مُتَحَرِّكًا، فَابْقَ عَلَيْهِ وَفَرَامِلُهُ مُقْفَلَةْ.
ضَعِ الْهَاتِفَ أَمَامَكَ عَلَى بُعْدِ مِتْرَيْنِ إِلَى ثَلَاثَةِ أَمْتَارْ، بِارْتِفَاعِ صَدْرِكَ تَقْرِيبًا، وَوَاجِهْهْ.
اِرْفَعْ ذِرَاعَكَ بِبُطْءٍ إِلَى الْجَانِبْ، إِلَى أَعْلَى ارْتِفَاعٍ مُرِيحٍ لَكْ.

ar: تحرك ضمن المدى المريح لك فقط، ولا تتجاوز حد الألم أبدًا.
ارفع ذراعك بنفسك، دون الاستعانة بيدك الأخرى أو بعصا أو بحبل وبكرة أو بشخص آخر.
إذا كان كتفك الأضعف مؤلمًا أو تشعر بأنه رخو، فأرح تلك الذراع على فخذك، وسنتخطى تلك الجهة.
توقف فورًا إذا شعرت بألم حاد أو متزايد، أو أحسست بأن كتفك ينزلق أو يعلق، أو امتد تنميل إلى أسفل ذراعك، أو شعرت بدوخة أو ضيق في التنفس أو ألم في الصدر.
en: Move only within a comfortable range. Never push into pain.
Lift your arm on your own. Do not use your other hand, a stick, a pulley or another person to help.
If your weaker shoulder hurts or feels loose, rest that arm on your lap. We will skip that side.
Stop at once if you feel sharp or increasing pain, your shoulder slips or catches, tingling spreads down your arm, or you feel dizzy, short of breath or have chest pain.
arTts: تَحَرَّكْ ضِمْنَ الْمَدَى الْمُرِيحِ لَكَ فَقَطْ، وَلَا تَتَجَاوَزْ حَدَّ الْأَلَمِ أَبَدًا.
اِرْفَعْ ذِرَاعَكَ بِنَفْسِكْ، دُونَ الِاسْتِعَانَةِ بِيَدِكَ الْأُخْرَى أَوْ بِعَصًا أَوْ بِحَبْلٍ وَبَكَرَةٍ أَوْ بِشَخْصٍ آخَرْ.
إِذَا كَانَ كَتِفُكَ الْأَضْعَفُ مُؤْلِمًا أَوْ تَشْعُرُ بِأَنَّهُ رَخْوْ، فَأَرِحْ تِلْكَ الذِّرَاعَ عَلَى فَخِذِكْ، وَسَنَتَخَطَّى تِلْكَ الْجِهَةْ.

تَوَقَّفْ فَوْرًا إِذَا شَعَرْتَ بِأَلَمٍ حَادٍّ أَوْ مُتَزَايِدْ، أَوْ أَحْسَسْتَ بِأَنَّ كَتِفَكَ يَنْزَلِقُ أَوْ يَعْلَقْ، أَوِ امْتَدَّ تَنْمِيلٌ إِلَى أَسْفَلِ ذِرَاعِكْ، أَوْ شَعَرْتَ بِدَوْخَةٍ أَوْ ضِيقٍ فِي التَّنَفُّسِ أَوْ أَلَمٍ فِي الصَّدْرْ.

tests.stepsRule: The card (S28) shows these three steps in order: where to sit, where the phone goes, the movement (simplicity cut C12). At the booth our team sets the chair and the phone, so the card shows the booth seat line and the movement. Calibration, practice, rests and the count are spoken when they apply.

tests.viewAllowance: anterolateral up to 30 degrees toward the front when a wheelchair part hides the hand

ask.ar: ماذا ستمسك في هذا الاختبار؟
ask.en: What will you hold for this test?

options.detail: half a liter, 1 liter or 1.5 liters (bottleSizes, shown and spoken in words: Q30), same bottle, filled to the same line, closed

help.ar: اختر شيئًا تستطيع رفعه عشرين مرة دون ألم، ودون أن تتعب. لا بأس بوزن خفيف أو بدون وزن. استخدم الشيء نفسه في كل مرة.
help.en: Choose something you can lift 20 times without pain and without getting tired. A light weight, or no weight at all, is fine. Use the same one every time.

helpWeakerArm.ar: لذراعك الأضعف، أجرِ هذا الاختبار دون وزن.
helpWeakerArm.en: For your weaker arm, do this test without a weight.

gripAsk.ar: هل ترتجف هذه اليد، أو قبضتها ضعيفة، أو تشعر فيها بخدر؟
gripAsk.en: Does this hand shake, or is your grip weak or numb?

practiceCheck.ar: هل كانت الثنيتان التجريبيتان كاملتين وسهلتين، دون ألم؟
practiceCheck.en: Were both practice bends full and easy, without pain?
practiceCheck.arTts: هَلْ كَانَتِ الثَّنْيَتَانِ التَّجْرِيبِيَّتَانِ كَامِلَتَيْنِ وَسَهْلَتَيْنْ، دُونَ أَلَمْ؟

stepDown.ar: اختر وزنًا أخف، أو بدون وزن.
stepDown.en: Choose a lighter weight, or none.

rules: Offered at the baseline for each arm, at home only; locked per arm afterwards. Step down order: chosen load, 1.5 kg, 1 kg, 0.5 kg, none. Dumbbells 0.5 to 4 kg in 0.5 kg steps; wrist weights up to 2 kg; bottles half a liter, 1 liter or 1.5 liters (Q5).

Booth: the arm curl runs without weight (arm_only) for everyone, so the load, grip and practice load screens are not shown there, and no dumbbells are bought or brought for the booth. Load selection first appears at the person's first home check (Q5).
No Senior Fitness Test kilogram values appear in the app, and there is no purchase suggestion or shop link for weights in v1 (Q5).
An arm set to arm_only by a rule skips the load, grip and practice load screens for that arm (P2).
Elastic bands are not allowed for the test.

arm_only is forced by: restriction no_resistance; clearance no or unsure; shoulder, elbow or wrist pain on that side (setup.painSides); pc_weak_shoulder yes for the weaker arm; a surgery area on that arm without clearance, or chest or belly (pc_surgery_recent).

Stroke with a declared weaker side: the weaker arm is arm_only in v1 at home and at the booth, whatever the pc_weak_shoulder answer, and the load help shows helpWeakerArm. Subluxation is often painless at first and not reliably self reported, and the hanging start position is when limb weight pulls the humeral head from the glenoid. A held or cuff load on that arm needs setup.weakShoulderCleared, a clinician confirmation that is not collected in v1 (Q8).
gripAsk is asked per arm at the baseline. Yes: only a wrist weight, a closed plastic bottle, or none. pc_arm_function bend_no_hold: wrist weight or none.

For parkinsons, ms, cerebral_palsy, sci_complete and sci_incomplete the dumbbell is not offered at home in v1 (a dropped weight on a foot with reduced feeling may go unnoticed, and in SCI a skin injury below the injury is an AD trigger).
A load change, object change, held versus cuff change, or variant change starts a new series (not comparable).

triggers: 3 consecutive checks at or above baseline plus band (verdict higher) with the same load on that arm
a count of 25 or more at 2 consecutive checks with the same load on that arm
progression.step: One step only: plus 0.5 kg for a dumbbell or a wrist weight, or the next bottle size; never above 4 kg for a dumbbell or 2 kg for a wrist weight.
neverOffered: an arm whose load or arm_only was set by a rule (stroke weaker arm in v1, no_resistance, clearance no or not sure, arm pain on that side, pc_weak_shoulder yes, surgery on that arm without clearance, chest or belly surgery)
a dumbbell at home with parkinsons, ms, cerebral_palsy, sci_complete or sci_incomplete
a dumbbell after a grip yes on that arm (only a wrist weight, a closed plastic bottle or nothing)
while an ac_next_day lasting answer is unresolved
when bt_pain_after was a little more or worse on that arm at any of the qualifying checks
progression.then: The first check with the new load runs the practice check with its step down again. The old series stays in history.

offer.ar: ربما أصبح هذا الوزن خفيفًا عليك. يمكنك إن أردت أن تبدأ سلسلة قياسات جديدة بوزن أثقل قليلًا، وتبقى نتائجك السابقة في سجلك.
offer.en: This weight may have become light for you. If you like, you can start a new series of checks with a slightly heavier weight. Your earlier results stay in your history.

progression.buttonRule: Two buttons of equal size and weight, none preselected.

metric.definition: Interior elbow angle (tested side shoulder, elbow, wrist) in pixel space (D-003), 2D x and y only, smoothed (One Euro, or about 150 ms Savitzky Golay).
metric.personalRange: Baseline: the 2 practice bends give extension angle E (arm hanging) and flexion angle F (top of the bend); F is the more flexed of the two practice bends, and if the two excursions differ by more than 15 percent a third practice bend is added. Excursion X = E minus F. X under 30 degrees after two tries of setup: not measured (quality).
metric.countLine: Progress p = (start angle minus current angle) / X, where start angle is today’s resting hanging angle. A rep counts when p rises to 0.80 or more after p was 0.20 or less since the previous counted rep (count line 0.80, return line 0.20).
metric.d009: At later checks X comes from the baseline of that series (stored rangeLo and rangeHi), anchored at today’s resting start angle. Practice bends still run; if they do not reach the count line, cue test_curl_full and the phone setup check, then count against the baseline line and flag range_below_baseline. A range_below_baseline result is shown with its values, without a verdict and without the large drop message, because a smaller apparent range can come from the camera (a loose sleeve hiding the elbow, a view change within the same class).
metric.endRule: Only reps whose count line crossing happens before 30.0 s after go are counted, unless Chaker confirms from the Senior Fitness Test manual before the Oct 9 freeze that a bend more than halfway up at 30 s counts; then the arm curl uses the chair stand rule (p of 0.50 or more and rising at 30.0 s counts one). One config flag, armCurlHalfwayCredit (default false), set before the freeze; after the freeze a change needs a movement version major bump, which starts a new series (Q4, Q28).
metric.display: The on screen counter freezes at 30.0 s; any halfway credit appears only on the result screen, so the number never changes after the voice says stop (Q4).
metric.partial: A bend that peaks between p 0.50 and 0.80 is partial and not counted; stored in detail.partial.
metric.compensated: Counted but flagged when the upper arm moves more than 20 degrees from its start orientation against the trunk line, or trunk pitch changes more than 12 degrees. Stored in detail.compensated. Never used to scold. A verdict is shown only when the share of compensated reps differs by 25 percentage points or less between baseline and now; otherwise noVerdict.movementDifferent.
metric.occlusion: Gate landmark visibility under 0.6 pauses scoring and prompts. If over 20 percent of the 30 s is unscored, the attempt fails the quality gate: offer one repeat after 2 minutes of rest, else not measured.

wideWhen: arthritis with pain on this arm (setup.painSides)
noiseBandRules.firstRetest: At the first re-test of each series the band is widened by 1 count in both directions; from the second re-test on, the normal band applies. The chart's shaded zone shows the band actually used (Q27, simplicity cut C42).
noVerdictWhen: compensated share differs by more than 25 percentage points
poseModel differs between baseline and now: wide band instead
noiseBandRules.label: calc, extrapolated from the Dahlberg 2025 home to supervised ratio

sideRules: Order: weaker arm first, then the other; support none: right then left. Keep the order at every check.
Side with arm limb loss: not measured; the other arm only.
Weaker arm that cannot lift off the lap (pc_weak_lift no): not measured, never zero.
Weaker arm with a painful or loose shoulder (pc_weak_shoulder yes): arm_only.
Stroke with a declared weaker side: the weaker arm is arm_only in v1 (see the load rules).
ms with a weaker side: may test only the weaker arm (pc_ms_one_arm).
Each arm is its own series. Never compare the two arms in the UI.

needs: armless steady chair, or own wheelchair with the test side armrest removed or flipped when that is safe
equipment.consistency: Same object, same kg, same held or cuff, same chair or wheelchair, same armrest state, same phone side and angle.

setup.view: side on to the tested arm (sagittal)
setup.framing: head to hips plus the hanging hand and weight
other: move the phone to the other side for the second arm (or turn the chair)
sleeves that contrast with the background
a helper may be in the picture, never between the phone and the person, and never touching

spasm or cramp that does not settle
the person presses stop or says a stop word

blocking: load kg, object, held versus cuff, variant
recorded: Parkinson dose bucket and on state

purpose.en: Shows how many full arm bends you can do in 30 seconds, with each arm.

ar: اجلس مستقيمًا على كرسي ثابت بلا مساند للذراعين، أو على كرسي أُزيل منه مسند الذراع في جهة الذراع التي تختبرها، أو على كرسيك المتحرك وفرامله مقفلة. أسند ظهرك إلى ظهر الكرسي، واجعل قدميك مسنودتين.
اجعل جانبك الذي فيه الذراع التي تختبرها نحو الهاتف. ضع الهاتف على بعد متر ونصف إلى مترين، بارتفاع صدرك تقريبًا.
اثنِ مرفقك إلى الأعلى تمامًا، ثم مُدّه إلى الأسفل تمامًا. إذا كان ذلك مريحًا، فأدر راحة يدك إلى الأعلى وأنت ترفع، وافعل ذلك بالطريقة نفسها في كل مرة.
en: Sit tall on a steady chair without armrests, or with the armrest removed on the side you test, or in your wheelchair with the brakes on. Rest your back against the backrest and keep your feet supported.
Turn so the side with the arm you are testing faces the phone. Place the phone 1.5 to 2 meters away, at about chest height.
Bend your elbow all the way up, then straighten it all the way down. If it is comfortable, turn your palm up as you lift, and do it the same way each time.
arTts: اِجْلِسْ مُسْتَقِيمًا عَلَى كُرْسِيٍّ ثَابِتٍ بِلَا مَسَانِدَ لِلذِّرَاعَيْنْ، أَوْ عَلَى كُرْسِيٍّ أُزِيلَ مِنْهُ مِسْنَدُ الذِّرَاعِ فِي جِهَةِ الذِّرَاعِ الَّتِي تَخْتَبِرُهَا، أَوْ عَلَى كُرْسِيِّكَ الْمُتَحَرِّكِ وَفَرَامِلُهُ مُقْفَلَةْ. أَسْنِدْ ظَهْرَكَ إِلَى ظَهْرِ الْكُرْسِيّ، وَاجْعَلْ قَدَمَيْكَ مَسْنُودَتَيْنْ.
اِجْعَلْ جَانِبَكَ الَّذِي فِيهِ الذِّرَاعُ الَّتِي تَخْتَبِرُهَا نَحْوَ الْهَاتِفْ. ضَعِ الْهَاتِفَ عَلَى بُعْدِ مِتْرٍ وَنِصْفٍ إِلَى مِتْرَيْنْ، بِارْتِفَاعِ صَدْرِكَ تَقْرِيبًا.

اِثْنِ مِرْفَقَكَ إِلَى الْأَعْلَى تَمَامًا، ثُمَّ مُدَّهُ إِلَى الْأَسْفَلِ تَمَامًا. إِذَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ مُرِيحًا، فَأَدِرْ رَاحَةَ يَدِكَ إِلَى الْأَعْلَى وَأَنْتَ تَرْفَعْ، وَافْعَلْ ذَلِكَ بِالطَّرِيقَةِ نَفْسِهَا فِي كُلِّ مَرَّةْ.

ar: استخدم الوزن نفسه والكرسي نفسه في كل مرة. لا بأس بقارورة ماء إذا كانت القارورة نفسها، مملوءة إلى الحد نفسه ومغلقة.
لا تستخدم شريطًا مطاطيًا في هذا الاختبار.
أبعد قدميك عن مسار الوزن تحسبًا لانزلاقه. وإذا بدأ الوزن ينزلق من يدك، فتوقف وضعه جانبًا.
تنفس بشكل طبيعي، ولا تحبس نفسك.
توقف فورًا إذا شعرت بألم في الصدر، أو دوخة، أو ضيق تنفس غير معتاد، أو صداع نابض، أو خدر جديد، أو ألم حاد في الكتف أو المرفق أو الرسغ.
en: Use the same weight and the same chair every time. A water bottle is fine if it is the same bottle, filled to the same line and closed.
Do not use an elastic band for this test.
Keep your feet clear in case the weight slips. If your grip slips, stop and put the weight down.
Breathe normally. Do not hold your breath.
Stop at once if you feel chest pain, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, a pounding headache, new numbness, or sharp pain in your shoulder, elbow or wrist.
arTts: اِسْتَخْدِمِ الْوَزْنَ نَفْسَهُ وَالْكُرْسِيَّ نَفْسَهُ فِي كُلِّ مَرَّةْ. لَا بَأْسَ بِقَارُورَةِ مَاءٍ إِذَا كَانَتِ الْقَارُورَةَ نَفْسَهَا، مَمْلُوءَةً إِلَى الْحَدِّ نَفْسِهِ وَمُغْلَقَةْ.
لَا تَسْتَخْدِمْ شَرِيطًا مَطَّاطِيًّا فِي هَذَا الِاخْتِبَارْ.
أَبْعِدْ قَدَمَيْكَ عَنْ مَسَارِ الْوَزْنِ تَحَسُّبًا لِانْزِلَاقِهْ. وَإِذَا بَدَأَ الْوَزْنُ يَنْزَلِقُ مِنْ يَدِكْ، فَتَوَقَّفْ وَضَعْهُ جَانِبًا.
تَنَفَّسْ بِشَكْلٍ طَبِيعِيّ، وَلَا تَحْبِسْ نَفَسَكْ.

تَوَقَّفْ فَوْرًا إِذَا شَعَرْتَ بِأَلَمٍ فِي الصَّدْرْ، أَوْ دَوْخَةْ، أَوْ ضِيقِ تَنَفُّسٍ غَيْرِ مُعْتَادْ، أَوْ صُدَاعٍ نَابِضْ، أَوْ خَدَرٍ جَدِيدْ، أَوْ أَلَمٍ حَادٍّ فِي الْكَتِفِ أَوِ الْمِرْفَقِ أَوِ الرُّسْغْ.

cardNotes.showIf: the person sits on a chair (not a wheelchair) with a fixed armrest on the tested side (O41)
cardNotes.ar: إذا كان لكرسيك مسند ذراع ثابت في جهة الذراع التي تختبرها، فانتقل إلى كرسي بلا مساند للذراعين إن كان ذلك آمنًا لك، أو تخطَّ هذا الاختبار اليوم.
cardNotes.arTts: إِذَا كَانَ لِكُرْسِيِّكَ مِسْنَدُ ذِرَاعٍ ثَابِتٌ فِي جِهَةِ الذِّرَاعِ الَّتِي تَخْتَبِرُهَا، فَانْتَقِلْ إِلَى كُرْسِيٍّ بِلَا مَسَانِدَ لِلذِّرَاعَيْنِ إِنْ كَانَ ذَلِكَ آمِنًا لَكْ، أَوْ تَخَطَّ هَذَا الِاخْتِبَارَ الْيَوْمْ.
cardNotes.en: If your chair has a fixed armrest on the side you test, move to a chair without armrests if that is safe for you, or skip this test today.
cardNotes.rule: Shown on the S28 card with the safety notes. The person never sits sideways or at the edge of the seat so that the tested arm clears an armrest; the chair change happens while the person turns side on (step 2). The chair and armrest state stay blocking comparability fields (O41).
