tests.stepsRule: The card (S28) shows these three steps in order: where to sit, where the phone goes, the movement (simplicity cut C12). At the booth our team sets the chair and the phone, so the card shows the booth seat line and the movement. Calibration, practice, rests and the count are spoken when they apply.
tests.safetyLoadOnlyRule: These bullets are about the load and show only when the arm curl runs with a load (any arm not arm_only); the stop bullet always shows (simplicity cut C13).

substituteFor.when: chair_stand_30s is excluded by an intake level rule

attemptCounter.rule: A large attempt counter readable from 2 m, for example 2 من 3 · 2 of 3 (P3).

tests.armMode: light_touch: hands rest on thighs or armrests; the hand on the leaning side slides as a light touch; a weaker arm stays supported on the lap

metric.definition: Trunk lean L = angle of the vector mid hip to mid shoulder from image vertical, pixel space (D-003), corrected by phone roll when the orientation sensor is available.
metric.upright: Upright baseline U = median of L over a 3 s still window (still means SD of L at most 2 degrees). Taken before the first lean of each check. If no still window occurs within 10 s (dyskinesia, athetosis), U = median of the 3 s window with the lowest SD, flagged upright_unsteady, and the wide band applies. If that SD is over 5 degrees, the test is not measured today (quality).
metric.attemptValue: For a lean toward side s: the maximum over time of the rolling 0.5 s window minimum of (L minus U) signed toward s. The sign of the lean is defined from the person’s shoulder landmark labels at U and checked against the asked for direction, as in 4.0. If the peak lean goes beyond the centre band toward the opposite side, the attempt is invalid (reason wrong_side): it is not stored as 0, and the asked for side is cued again (test_trunk_lean_left or test_trunk_lean_right).
metric.pivot: When hip visibility drops during the lean, the mid hip is fixed at its median position from well visible baseline frames. If hips are not visible at baseline, the test is not measured today (quality) with a setup tip.
metric.returnBand: Centre band = U plus or minus max(3 degrees, 2 x SD of the upright window). returnSec = time from the peak until L stays inside the band for 1 s. Stored, never shown. No return within 10 s: cue test_trunk_to_middle and flag no_return.
metric.secondary: Shoulder midpoint lateral shift / baseline shoulder width, stored in detail.shoulderShift for every attempt (not shown).
invalidWhen: projected trunk length shrinks more than 15 percent (forward bend instead of side lean)
apparent shoulder width changes more than 15 percent (rotation)
mid hip moves sideways more than 0.25 shoulder widths when hips are visible (sliding or hitching)
peak lean toward the opposite side (wrong_side)
flags: head only tilt (ear line tilts, shoulder midpoint barely moves)
wrist on thigh or armrest (cannot tell touch from push)
arm_support_likely: leaning side elbow angle over 150 degrees at the peak (tune at booth); a flagged attempt is excluded from verdicts

contactAsk.ar: عند نهاية الميل، هل استند جسمك أو ذراعك إلى مسند الذراع؟
contactAsk.en: At the end of the lean, did your body or arm rest on the armrest?
contactAsk.arTts: عِنْدَ نِهَايَةِ الْمَيْلْ، هَلِ اسْتَنَدَ جِسْمُكَ أَوْ ذِرَاعُكَ إِلَى مِسْنَدِ الذِّرَاعْ؟

metric.contact: Asked after each side, answered by a tap. Yes stores contact: true; that side’s attempts are censored (at least the value) and cannot produce higher. With contact on that side at both checks, show values with noVerdict.chairLimit.
abort: lean speed over 45 degrees per second for more than 0.2 s
lean more than 15 degrees beyond this side’s best at earlier checks
at the first check, lean over 30 degrees
shoulder or hip landmarks lost mid lean
metric.abortNature: The abort rules are coaching cues (voice test_trunk_to_middle), not safeguards: a voice cue cannot stop a fall. Safety comes from the armrests on both sides, the helper rules and the pre-check gates. The first check value of 30 degrees is a conservative starting point until Azm has data (tune at booth).
metric.censoring: An aborted attempt is stored with censored: true and value = the abort threshold, and it is never the displayed best. If the best valid attempt is censored, the result shows more than {value} with no lower verdict; a censored value above baseline plus band may show higher. When the baseline best is censored, later checks show values without a verdict.

requiredLandmarks.rejectIf: gate landmarks under 0.5 in more than 20 percent of frames

noiseBandRules.baseline: Two check baseline: the baseline for each side is the mean of the first two completed checks of the series. The second check shows the startingPointSet sentence instead of a verdict.

default.formula: max(8, round(0.30 x baseline side value))

wide.formula: max(10, round(0.35 x baseline side value))

wideWhen: conditions include parkinsons or cerebral_palsy (involuntary movement)
noiseBandRules.confirmation: higher or lower only when this check is beyond the band AND the mean of this and the previous check is beyond the band, in the same direction. Otherwise the verdict is about the same with the unconfirmed sentence.
noVerdictWhen: fewer than 2 valid attempts on that side at either check
contact on that side at both checks (noVerdict.chairLimit)

sideRules: Start toward the stronger side (support none: toward the right), then alternate.

At home, a steady chair with no wheels and no swivel with armrests on both sides, or wheelchair side guards or armrests on both sides with the brakes on, for every user (pc_trunk_armrests, asked by position: Q12). Without them: armrests_needed.

Helper at home (pc_helper yes, then the helper briefing and its confirm tap) for sci_complete, sci_incomplete, stroke, cerebral_palsy, parkinsons, ms, and for everyone’s first home side lean. Otherwise the test is skipped today (helper_needed).
pc_stroke_push yes: excluded in v1 (pusher), at home and at the booth.
Hip pain: comfort only instructions; today score 6 skips the test.
Each side is its own series. Never show asymmetry as a score.

needs: steady chair with a backrest and armrests on both sides, back against a wall, about 1 m clear each side; or own wheelchair with armrests or side guards on both sides
equipment.consistency: Same chair or wheelchair, same armrests or side guards, same cushion, same tilt, same belt, same prosthesis state, same arm mode.

other: wheelchair: brakes on, casters forward, anti tippers on if fitted, power chair switched off, usual belt fastened, feet on footplates
blankets or bags off the lap

one person in the chair; the helper or booth spotter sits or stands close beside the person on the weaker side (support none: the left), a little behind, hands near the shoulder without touching; in the picture if needed, never between the phone and the person

stopRules.sign: feels about to fall or grabs for support
new or increasing back, hip, shoulder or neck pain

stopRules.route: attempt ends with a cue; the test continues if the person is fine

stopRules.sign: the person presses stop or says a stop word
stopRules.route: the person chooses on the stop list

blocking: chest strap or lateral supports (excluded anyway)
pivot method (visible hip versus fixed pivot)

purpose.ar: يُظهر إلى أي مدى تستطيع الميل إلى كل جانب وأنت جالس ثم العودة بنفسك.
purpose.en: Shows how far you can lean to each side while sitting, and come back on your own.

ar: اجلس في عمق المقعد، وقدماك على الأرض أو على مسند القدمين.
ضع الهاتف أمامك على بعد مترين تقريبًا، بارتفاع صدرك، وواجهه.
مِل ببطء إلى أحد الجانبين، فقط بالقدر الذي تثق أنك تعود منه بنفسك. ودع يدك تنزلق بخفة على فخذك أو على مسند الذراع، دون ضغط.
en: Sit back in the seat with your feet flat on the floor or on the footplates.
Place the phone in front of you, about 2 meters away, at chest height, and face it.
Slowly lean to one side, only as far as you are sure you can come back from on your own. Let your hand slide lightly along your thigh or the armrest, without pushing.
arTts: اِجْلِسْ فِي عُمْقِ الْمَقْعَدْ، وَقَدَمَاكَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ أَوْ عَلَى مِسْنَدِ الْقَدَمَيْنْ.
ضَعِ الْهَاتِفَ أَمَامَكَ عَلَى بُعْدِ مِتْرَيْنِ تَقْرِيبًا، بِارْتِفَاعِ صَدْرِكْ، وَوَاجِهْهْ.

مِلْ بِبُطْءٍ إِلَى أَحَدِ الْجَانِبَيْنْ، فَقَطْ بِالْقَدْرِ الَّذِي تَثِقُ أَنَّكَ تَعُودُ مِنْهُ بِنَفْسِكْ. وَدَعْ يَدَكَ تَنْزَلِقُ بِخِفَّةٍ عَلَى فَخِذِكَ أَوْ عَلَى مِسْنَدِ الذِّرَاعْ، دُونَ ضَغْطْ.

ar: مِل ببطء، وبالقدر الذي تثق أنك تستطيع العودة منه بنفسك فقط.
استخدم يدك لمسًا خفيفًا للأمان فقط، ولا تسحب ذراعك الأضعف أبدًا.
اطلب من شخص بالغ آخر أن يجلس أو يقف بجانبك أثناء هذا الاختبار.
توقف إذا شعرت بأنك قد تسقط أو تحتاج إلى الإمساك بشيء، أو شعرت بدوخة، أو حدث لك تشنج، أو شعرت بألم جديد أو متزايد في الظهر أو الورك أو الكتف أو الرقبة.
en: Lean slowly, and only as far as you are sure you can come back on your own.
Use your hand only as a light touch for safety. Never pull on a weaker arm.
Have another adult sit or stand beside you for this test.
Stop if you feel you might fall or need to grab something, feel dizzy, have a spasm, or feel new or increasing pain in your back, hip, shoulder or neck.
arTts: مِلْ بِبُطْءْ، وَبِالْقَدْرِ الَّذِي تَثِقُ أَنَّكَ تَسْتَطِيعُ الْعَوْدَةَ مِنْهُ بِنَفْسِكَ فَقَطْ.
اِسْتَخْدِمْ يَدَكَ لَمْسًا خَفِيفًا لِلْأَمَانِ فَقَطْ، وَلَا تَسْحَبْ ذِرَاعَكَ الْأَضْعَفَ أَبَدًا.
اُطْلُبْ مِنْ شَخْصٍ بَالِغٍ آخَرَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ أَوْ يَقِفَ بِجَانِبِكَ أَثْنَاءَ هَذَا الِاخْتِبَارْ.

تَوَقَّفْ إِذَا شَعَرْتَ بِأَنَّكَ قَدْ تَسْقُطُ أَوْ تَحْتَاجُ إِلَى الْإِمْسَاكِ بِشَيْءْ، أَوْ شَعَرْتَ بِدَوْخَةْ، أَوْ حَدَثَ لَكَ تَشَنُّجْ، أَوْ شَعَرْتَ بِأَلَمٍ جَدِيدٍ أَوْ مُتَزَايِدٍ فِي الظَّهْرِ أَوِ الْوَرِكِ أَوِ الْكَتِفِ أَوِ الرَّقَبَةْ.

resultSentence.ar: بلغ ميلك إلى {side} {value} {unit} من جلستك المستقيمة.
resultSentence.en: You leaned {value} {unit} to your {side} from sitting upright.

tests.stepsRule: The card (S28) shows these three steps in order: where to sit, where the phone goes, the movement (simplicity cut C12). At the booth our team sets the chair and the phone, so the card shows the booth seat line and the movement. Calibration, practice, rests and the count are spoken when they apply.

tests.viewNote: Oblique 45 degree view from the front and the stronger side (support none: right). The helper stands on the weaker side, away from the phone, so the helper is never between the phone and the person, and the stronger arm, the one most likely to push, stays in view. The view gate must accept front or unknown for this test and reject a pure side view.

2.ar: يمكنك الاستعانة بيديك على مساند الذراعين أو على فخذيك للوقوف والجلوس، ثم ارفع يديك عن السند كلما وقفت.
2.en: You may push with your hands on the armrests or your thighs to stand and to sit. Take your hands off the support each time you are standing.
2.arTts: يُمْكِنُكَ الِاسْتِعَانَةُ بِيَدَيْكَ عَلَى مَسَانِدِ الذِّرَاعَيْنِ أَوْ عَلَى فَخِذَيْكَ لِلْوُقُوفِ وَالْجُلُوسْ، ثُمَّ ارْفَعْ يَدَيْكَ عَنِ السَّنَدِ كُلَّمَا وَقَفْتْ.

label.ar: مع الاستعانة باليدين، والثبات قبل رفعهما عن السند
label.en: Hands allowed, steady before letting go

variants.when: arms_assisted at home with pc_walking_aid yes (a modifier of arms_assisted, same series)

2.ar: يمكنك الاستعانة بيديك على مساند الذراعين أو على فخذيك للوقوف والجلوس. في كل مرة، قف وخذ لحظة حتى تشعر بالثبات، ثم ارفع يديك عن السند.
2.en: You may push with your hands on the armrests or your thighs to stand and to sit. Each time, stand up, get steady, then take your hands off the support.
2.arTts: يُمْكِنُكَ الِاسْتِعَانَةُ بِيَدَيْكَ عَلَى مَسَانِدِ الذِّرَاعَيْنِ أَوْ عَلَى فَخِذَيْكَ لِلْوُقُوفِ وَالْجُلُوسْ. فِي كُلِّ مَرَّةْ، قِفْ وَخُذْ لَحْظَةً حَتَّى تَشْعُرَ بِالثَّبَاتْ، ثُمَّ ارْفَعْ يَدَيْكَ عَنِ السَّنَدْ.

2.ar: ضع يدك على الكتف المقابل، وأبقِ ذراعك الأخرى، أو طرفك الصناعي إن كنت ترتديه، قريبة من صدرك.
2.en: Place your hand on the opposite shoulder. Keep your other arm, or your prosthesis if you wear one, close to your chest.
2.arTts: ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الْكَتِفِ الْمُقَابِلْ، وَأَبْقِ ذِرَاعَكَ الْأُخْرَى، أَوْ طَرَفَكَ الصِّنَاعِيَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَرْتَدِيهْ، قَرِيبَةً مِنْ صَدْرِكْ.

variants.armCue: Where test_stand_arms_cross would play, the camera part plays this variant's step line (stepsReplace 4, display and arTts): spoken only once Nasser approves it by ear (voicePending), captioned until then with its short form (R3C-26). The short form is proposed by the UI/UX seat; the Arabic seat confirms it.

variantRules: standard unless any of these apply, then arms_assisted: pc_stand_no_hands no or unsure; any pc_steadi yes; pc_walking_aid yes; conditions stroke with a declared weaker side, sci_incomplete or cerebral_palsy.
The variant is stored and never compared across variants. Moving from arms_assisted to standard is shown as a milestone, not as a change in count.

Arms used (standard and one_arm_cross): a wrist with visibility 0.7 or more that is at or below mid hip height, or within 0.3 shoulder widths of the thigh line, for 0.3 s or more while rising. Low wrist visibility means unknown, never arms used. In one_arm_cross only the intact side wrist is checked, and it must stay at the opposite shoulder; the limb loss side elbow and wrist are ignored (the model places a missing limb at an average position).

When arms are used in the standard or one_arm_cross version, the test stops. At home the app first asks pushedAsk. Yes: reason needed_arms, no score, and the next check offers arms_assisted. No: the attempt is a quality failure (not measured today) and the variant is kept.

arms_assisted with a painful, loose or recently operated shoulder, elbow or wrist on one side (areas map, pc_weak_shoulder, pc_surgery_recent): push with the other hand only (pushHand recorded; a change of pushHand gives the wide band). Both sides affected: skip (pain_today, flare or recent_surgery).

arms_assisted_steady (walking aid users at home): test_stand_steady plays at each stand, pauses are allowed and the clock keeps running, and reaching for the support in front ends the test (needed_support, no score).

pushedAsk.en: Did you push with your hands to stand up?

helperRules: At home another adult must be present (pc_helper yes) for: arms_assisted; any pc_steadi yes; pc_walking_aid yes; parkinsons; stroke; sci_incomplete; cerebral_palsy; pc_pd_dizzy_standing yes.

Helper position: beside the person on the weaker side (support none: the left), slightly behind, one hand hovering near the waist without touching; in the picture if needed, never between the phone and the person. scr_helper_brief_stand is shown after pc_helper yes.
Without a helper the chair stand is skipped today (helper_needed). No substitute test is added for a same day skip.
After pc_helper yes, the helper briefing is shown and read aloud with the top down picture (helper place marked), and the test starts only after the tap on helperBriefing.confirmButton (Q11).
phase3: arms_assisted with the everyday prosthesis and a helper for lower limb loss, starting with below knee amputation and opening above knee only after that data (Q10)
with booth and pilot data, review the arms_assisted chair stand with a helper for intake hip or knee pain when today's area score is 3 or less (P6)

metric.definition: h = vertical distance from the mid ankle to the mid hip in pixel space (D-003), divided by the seated trunk length (mid shoulder to mid hip) measured in the seated calibration. When ankles are hidden, the seated mid hip height is the zero.
metric.personalRange: Seated baseline h_sit = median while still for at least 1 s. Standing reference h_stand = median during each practice stand, held about 1 s, with the trunk upright. Rise R = h_stand minus h_sit, and the baseline R is the larger of the two practice stands. If the two differ by more than 15 percent, a third practice stand is added.
metric.countLine: p = (h minus h_sit) / R. A stand counts when p reaches 0.85 or more, with shoulders over hips, after p was 0.15 or less (seated) since the previous counted stand. Shoulders over hips uses the vertical component only, which camera yaw does not change: (mid hip y minus mid shoulder y) is at least 0.9 times the same distance at the standing practice stand. A hover that does not return to 0.15 is not a new stand.
metric.d009: At later checks R comes from the baseline of that series; h_sit is measured again today. Count line = h_sit(today) + 0.85 x R(baseline); return line = h_sit(today) + 0.15 x R(baseline). R_today is computed from both practice stands. If R_today stays outside 0.85 to 1.15 times R(baseline) after one re-cue (test_stand_full), the count still runs against the baseline line, the result is flagged range_mismatch and shown without a verdict (noVerdict.setupDiffers). This is the pose based same chair check that Q9 lacked.
metric.endRule: At 30.0 s, if the person is rising and p is 0.50 or more, one stand is added (CDC STEADI more than halfway rule; Q4).
metric.display: The on screen counter freezes at 30.0 s; the halfway credit appears only on the result screen, so the number never changes after the voice says stop (Q4).
flags: sideways lean toward the stronger side (computed only when the view classifier returns front; otherwise stored as unknown, because in a 45 degree view the image horizontal mixes forward and sideways lean)
metric.countSource: auto, staff or self. auto = the camera count. staff = corrected at the booth by a staff member watching live (allowed, and usable as a baseline). self = confirmed or corrected by the person: stored and shown, never used as a baseline and never given a verdict (self counts read about 1.5 higher than a physiotherapist’s count: Dahlberg 2025).

noiseBandRules.firstRetest: At the first re-test of each series the band is widened by 1 count in both directions (on top of the wide band when that applies); from the second re-test on, the normal band applies. The chart's shaded zone shows the band actually used (Q27, simplicity cut C42).
noiseBandRules.label: calc, extrapolated from the Dahlberg 2025 home to supervised ratio

sideRules: No sides. Phone at 45 degrees on the stronger side (support none: right); helper on the weaker side (support none: left), away from the phone.

needs: firm chair about knee height (about 43 to 46 cm), no wheels, no swivel, no soft cushion, back against a wall, such as a dining chair; never a low sofa or floor seating
sturdy support within reach in front (a kitchen counter or a heavy table, never the back of a chair), a little toward the side away from the phone; never moved out of reach to clear the view
equipment.consistency: Same chair, same variant, same footwear or barefoot, same arm position.

setup.view: oblique 45 degrees from the front and the stronger side (no weaker side declared: the right)
setup.heightM: lens at about seat to hip height
setup.framing: whole body from the head at full stand to the feet
setup.picture: One top down picture on the setup screen: the chair against the wall, the phone at 45 degrees on the stronger side 2 to 3 m away, the support in front toward the side away from the phone, the helper beside the weaker side and slightly behind; mirrored for a weaker left or right side. The same picture is reused in the helper briefing (P4, Q11).
setup.clearView: When the hips (landmarks 23 and 24) are hidden at calibration, play check_clear_view (P4).
setup.booth: At the booth the phone, support and staff positions are fixed once and stay the same for every visitor (P4).
other: helper beside the person on the weaker side, slightly behind, one hand hovering near the waist without touching; in the picture if needed, never between the phone and the person

stopRules.sign: loss of balance, a stagger or a step
dizziness, light headedness or feeling faint
new or sharp hip, knee or back pain, or pain clearly above usual
standard or one_arm_cross version: arms used
stopRules.route: needed_arms after pushedAsk (not a symptom stop)

stopRules.sign: arms_assisted_steady: reaching for the support in front
camera, with the check in on: the person leaves the picture for 5 s, or no movement for 10 s
the person presses stop or says a stop word
stopRules.route: the person chooses on the stop list

blocking: chair (same chair yes or no, armrests)
recorded: poseModel (a change gives the wide band)

purpose.ar: يُظهر كم مرة تستطيع الوقوف كاملًا من الكرسي خلال 30 ثانية.
purpose.en: Shows how many times you can stand up fully from a chair in 30 seconds.

ar: اجلس في منتصف المقعد، وظهرك مستقيم، وقدماك على الأرض.
ضع الهاتف واقفًا على بعد مترين إلى ثلاثة أمتار، في منتصف المسافة بين أمامك وجانبك الأقوى، ليظهر جسمك كاملًا عندما تقف. إذا لم تكن إحدى جهتيك أضعف، فضعه جهة يمينك.
ضع ذراعيك متقاطعتين عند الرسغين، وأسندهما إلى صدرك.
en: Sit in the middle of the seat with your back straight and your feet flat on the floor.

Stand the phone upright 2 to 3 meters away, halfway between straight in front of you and your stronger side, so your whole body shows when you stand. If neither side is weaker, place it toward your right.
Cross your arms at the wrists and hold them against your chest.
arTts: اِجْلِسْ فِي مُنْتَصَفِ الْمَقْعَدْ، وَظَهْرُكَ مُسْتَقِيمْ، وَقَدَمَاكَ عَلَى الْأَرْضْ.

ضَعِ الْهَاتِفَ وَاقِفًا عَلَى بُعْدِ مِتْرَيْنِ إِلَى ثَلَاثَةِ أَمْتَارْ، فِي مُنْتَصَفِ الْمَسَافَةِ بَيْنَ أَمَامِكَ وَجَانِبِكَ الْأَقْوَى، لِيَظْهَرَ جِسْمُكَ كَامِلًا عِنْدَمَا تَقِفْ. إِذَا لَمْ تَكُنْ إِحْدَى جِهَتَيْكَ أَضْعَفْ، فَضَعْهُ جِهَةَ يَمِينِكْ.
ضَعْ ذِرَاعَيْكَ مُتَقَاطِعَتَيْنِ عِنْدَ الرُّسْغَيْنْ، وَأَسْنِدْهُمَا إِلَى صَدْرِكْ.

ar: أجرِ هذا الاختبار فقط إذا كنت تشعر بالثبات اليوم.
إذا كان معك أحد، فاطلب منه أن يقف قريبًا بجانبك في جهتك الأضعف، خلفك قليلًا. لا بأس أن يظهر في الصورة، على ألا يقف بينك وبين الهاتف.
ارتدِ الحذاء نفسه في كل مرة، أو كن حافيًا في كل مرة، على أرضية غير زلقة.
إذا احتجت إلى يديك للوقوف في النسخة ذات الذراعين المتقاطعتين، فتوقف، ولا بأس في ذلك. في المرة القادمة، سنستخدم النسخة التي تسمح لك بالاستعانة بيديك.
توقف فورًا إذا فقدت توازنك، أو شعرت بدوخة أو بأنك على وشك الإغماء، أو بألم في الصدر، أو بضيق تنفس غير معتاد، أو بتسارع ضربات القلب، أو بألم جديد أو حاد في الورك أو الركبة أو الظهر.
en: Do this test only if you feel steady today.
If someone is with you, ask them to stand close beside you on your weaker side, slightly behind you. They may be in the picture, but not between you and the phone.
Wear the same shoes each time, or be barefoot each time, on a floor that is not slippery.
If you need your hands to stand up in the version with crossed arms, stop. That is fine. Next time we will use the version that allows your hands.
Stop at once if you lose your balance, feel dizzy or faint, have chest pain, unusual shortness of breath or a racing heart, or feel new or sharp pain in your hip, knee or back.
arTts: أَجْرِ هَذَا الِاخْتِبَارَ فَقَطْ إِذَا كُنْتَ تَشْعُرُ بِالثَّبَاتِ الْيَوْمْ.

إِذَا كَانَ مَعَكَ أَحَدْ، فَاطْلُبْ مِنْهُ أَنْ يَقِفَ قَرِيبًا بِجَانِبِكَ فِي جِهَتِكَ الْأَضْعَفْ، خَلْفَكَ قَلِيلًا. لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَظْهَرَ فِي الصُّورَةْ، عَلَى أَلَّا يَقِفَ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الْهَاتِفْ.
اِرْتَدِ الْحِذَاءَ نَفْسَهُ فِي كُلِّ مَرَّةْ، أَوْ كُنْ حَافِيًا فِي كُلِّ مَرَّةْ، عَلَى أَرْضِيَّةٍ غَيْرِ زَلِقَةْ.

إِذَا احْتَجْتَ إِلَى يَدَيْكَ لِلْوُقُوفِ فِي النُّسْخَةِ ذَاتِ الذِّرَاعَيْنِ الْمُتَقَاطِعَتَيْنْ، فَتَوَقَّفْ، وَلَا بَأْسَ فِي ذَلِكْ. فِي الْمَرَّةِ الْقَادِمَةْ، سَنَسْتَخْدِمُ النُّسْخَةَ الَّتِي تَسْمَحُ لَكَ بِالِاسْتِعَانَةِ بِيَدَيْكْ.

تَوَقَّفْ فَوْرًا إِذَا فَقَدْتَ تَوَازُنَكْ، أَوْ شَعَرْتَ بِدَوْخَةٍ أَوْ بِأَنَّكَ عَلَى وَشْكِ الْإِغْمَاءْ، أَوْ بِأَلَمٍ فِي الصَّدْرْ، أَوْ بِضِيقِ تَنَفُّسٍ غَيْرِ مُعْتَادْ، أَوْ بِتَسَارُعِ ضَرَبَاتِ الْقَلْبْ، أَوْ بِأَلَمٍ جَدِيدٍ أَوْ حَادٍّ فِي الْوَرِكِ أَوِ الرُّكْبَةِ أَوِ الظَّهْرْ.

cardNotes.ar: إذا شعرت بعدم الثبات، فأمسك السند الذي أمامك فورًا. ينتهي الاختبار عندها، ولا بأس بذلك.
cardNotes.arTts: إِذَا شَعَرْتَ بِعَدَمِ الثَّبَاتْ، فَأَمْسِكِ السَّنَدَ الَّذِي أَمَامَكَ فَوْرًا. يَنْتَهِي الِاخْتِبَارُ عِنْدَهَا، وَلَا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكْ.
cardNotes.en: If you feel unsteady, hold the support in front of you straight away. The test ends there, and that is fine.
cardNotes.rule: Shown and spoken on the S28 card with the safety notes (O24-5). Reaching for the support in front ends the test with needed_support, no score (variantRules).

cardNotes.ar: ضع عصاك أو عكازك أو مشّايتك بجانب الكرسي في متناول يدك، لا أمامك، ولا تستند إليها أثناء الاختبار.
cardNotes.arTts: ضَعْ عَصَاكَ أَوْ عُكَّازَكَ أَوْ مَشَّايَتَكَ بِجَانِبِ الْكُرْسِيِّ فِي مُتَنَاوَلِ يَدِكْ، لَا أَمَامَكْ، وَلَا تَسْتَنِدْ إِلَيْهَا أَثْنَاءَ الِاخْتِبَارْ.
cardNotes.en: Put your cane, crutch or walker beside the chair within reach, not in front of you, and do not lean on it during the test.
cardNotes.rule: Shown and spoken on the S28 card with the safety notes, at home and at the booth (O24-5).

safetyPending.ar: توقف فورًا إذا فقدت توازنك، أو شعرت بدوخة أو بأنك على وشك الإغماء، أو بألم في الصدر، أو بضيق تنفس غير معتاد، أو بتسارع ضربات القلب، أو بألم جديد أو شديد أو مفاجئ كالطعنة في الورك أو الركبة أو الظهر.
safetyPending.arTts: تَوَقَّفْ فَوْرًا إِذَا فَقَدْتَ تَوَازُنَكْ، أَوْ شَعَرْتَ بِدَوْخَةٍ أَوْ بِأَنَّكَ عَلَى وَشْكِ الْإِغْمَاءْ، أَوْ بِأَلَمٍ فِي الصَّدْرْ، أَوْ بِضِيقِ تَنَفُّسٍ غَيْرِ مُعْتَادْ، أَوْ بِتَسَارُعِ ضَرَبَاتِ الْقَلْبْ، أَوْ بِأَلَمٍ جَدِيدٍ أَوْ شَدِيدٍ أَوْ مُفَاجِئٍ كَالطَّعْنَةِ فِي الْوَرِكِ أَوِ الرُّكْبَةِ أَوِ الظَّهْرْ.
safetyPending.en: Stop at once if you lose your balance, feel dizzy or faint, have chest pain, unusual shortness of breath or a racing heart, or feel new, severe or sudden sharp pain in your hip, knee or back.

ar: استخدم كرسيًا ثابتًا لا يدور، بلا عجلات ولا وسادة لينة، مثل كرسي السفرة، يصل مقعده إلى ثنية ركبتك من الخلف تقريبًا عندما تقف بجانبه، وأسند ظهره إلى الجدار. لا تستخدم كنبة منخفضة أو جلسة أرضية. وإذا كنت ستستعين بمساند الذراعين، فيجب أن تكون متينة.
ليكن أمامك شيء متين في متناول يدك، مثل طاولة المطبخ أو طاولة ثقيلة، على أن يكون أقرب إلى الجهة البعيدة عن الهاتف، فلا يقع بينك وبين الهاتف.
en: Use a firm chair that does not swivel, without wheels or a soft cushion, such as a dining chair, with the seat about as high as the back of your knee when you stand beside it, and put its back against a wall. Do not use a low sofa or floor seating. If you will push on armrests, they must be sturdy.
Have something sturdy within reach in front of you, such as a kitchen counter or a heavy table, a little toward the side away from the phone, so it is not between you and the phone.
arTts: اِسْتَخْدِمْ كُرْسِيًّا ثَابِتًا لَا يَدُورْ، بِلَا عَجَلَاتٍ وَلَا وِسَادَةٍ لَيِّنَةْ، مِثْلَ كُرْسِيِّ السُّفْرَةْ، يَصِلُ مَقْعَدُهُ إِلَى ثَنْيَةِ رُكْبَتِكَ مِنَ الْخَلْفِ تَقْرِيبًا عِنْدَمَا تَقِفُ بِجَانِبِهْ، وَأَسْنِدْ ظَهْرَهُ إِلَى الْجِدَارْ. لَا تَسْتَخْدِمْ كَنَبَةً مُنْخَفِضَةً أَوْ جَلْسَةً أَرْضِيَّةْ. وَإِذَا كُنْتَ سَتَسْتَعِينُ بِمَسَانِدِ الذِّرَاعَيْنْ، فَيَجِبُ أَنْ تَكُونَ مَتِينَةْ.

لِيَكُنْ أَمَامَكَ شَيْءٌ مَتِينٌ فِي مُتَنَاوَلِ يَدِكْ، مِثْلُ طَاوِلَةِ الْمَطْبَخِ أَوْ طَاوِلَةٍ ثَقِيلَةْ، عَلَى أَنْ يَكُونَ أَقْرَبَ إِلَى الْجِهَةِ الْبَعِيدَةِ عَنِ الْهَاتِفْ، فَلَا يَقَعُ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الْهَاتِفْ.
boothSetup.rule: Our team sets up the chair and the support in front at the booth; these lines are the staff setup tips (S58), never on the visitor's card.

tests.stepsRule: The card (S28) shows these three steps in order: where to sit, where the phone goes, the movement (simplicity cut C12). At the booth our team sets the chair and the phone, so the card shows the booth seat line and the movement. Calibration, practice, rests and the count are spoken when they apply.

progress.earlyCheck: Re-test due 28 days after the last completed check. The person may check earlier at any time from 48 hours after the last completed check, with no reason asked or stored; an early start shows scr_early_start with earlyStartButtons. After a lower, large drop or not comparable result, offer a repeat in 2 to 7 days. Never offer an early repeat while an ac_next_day lasting answer is unresolved (H9).
progress.boothToHome: A booth check does not set the home due date: the first home check is offered as soon as home checks open (Q31) and at least 48 hours after the booth check (H9).
progress.clinicianInterval: When the clinician portal arrives (phase 4, under its regulatory gate, H7), a clinician can set 14 to 56 days (H9).
progress.compareLikeWithLike: same testId, side, position, variant, setting (booth or home), fingerprint blocking fields and movement_version major. Booth checks form a booth series; the first home check starts the home series; the booth result stays visible as a separate point labelled boothPoint.
progress.values: whole degrees and whole counts; change computed on the stored whole numbers

same.en: About the same as your starting point

bandSentence.ar: قد يأتي تغير صغير من اختلاف بين يوم وآخر، ومن طريقة رؤية الكاميرا لك، لذلك نعدّه قريبًا من نقطة بدايتك. تُظهر المنطقة المظللة في الرسم حدود هذا التغير.
bandSentence.en: A small change can come from day to day differences and from how the camera sees you, so we read it as about the same. The shaded zone in a chart shows how small.

progress.shaddaRule: Every form of the verb عدّ in progress copy carries its shadda (نعدّ، نعدّه، نعدّها), including every noVerdict line (Q1).

bandReplacement.mdc: Azm's own MDC95 = 2.77 x within person SD, rounded up
bandReplacement.replacesOnlyWhen: 30 or more people per setup group with home repeats 2 to 14 days apart, each with a full re-setup; never from same day repeats or booth repeats
bandReplacement.floorRule: A replaced band is never narrower than the supervised published floor: arm raise 12 degrees, arm curl 3, chair stand 3, side lean 6 degrees.
bandReplacement.dataSource: Computed only from data collected under the ethics approved protocol (Q2), or from people who gave the separate research opt in (boundary.researchOptIn); never from results kept only under the personal tracking consent.

progress.boothExample: Computed by the same comparison code with these bands: one series card (one test, start and now, the verdict in words) with its example label and the sign up code (simplicity cut C37). Staff show it with the demo video to visitors routed to scr_booth_no_check (Q19).
progress.noVerdictDisplay: A side without a verdict is a normal result card showing start and now with its noVerdict sentence, never a greyed or error state (P1).
progress.skippedTests: S27 and the results screens name every skipped test in one muted line (Not today: {tests}.), then each distinct reason from 3.6 once in plain words, with reasonSuffixes.substituteRan only when the side lean actually ran in the chair stand slot (P6, simplicity cut C32).
progress.firstRetest: arm_curl_30s and chair_stand_30s: at the first re-test of each series the band is widened by 1 count in both directions; from the second re-test on, the normal band applies; the chart's shaded zone shows the band actually used (simplicity cut C42). The arm raise keeps a single baseline and the side lean its two check baseline, with no familiarisation session (Q27).
progress.digits: Decided (D-036 item 3, Nasser, replacing council Q30's Arabic Indic digits): Western digits 0 to 9 in every Arabic display string, with . as the decimal mark. Arabic copy in this file is authored with ASCII digits; at render time every {value}, {band}, {seconds}, {kg}, {n}, {time} or {date} token goes through the same formatter as fmtNum (Western digits, decimal mark ., for example 2.5 كغ), and any Arabic Indic digit in an Arabic display string is shown as its Western digit. The emergency and advice numbers show as 997 and 937 in both languages, in the text and in the tel: href (tel:997, tel:937). Latin codes such as T6 keep their form, and every Latin code or inserted number is wrapped in a bidi isolate (bdi, or U+2068 and U+2069) so it never flips inside RTL text. Every Arabic date uses calendar gregory (Q30) with Arabic month names and Western digits (11 أكتوبر 2026), including History.tsx. Bottle sizes are shown and spoken in words (bottleSizes). Speech input to the Arabic voice (arTts) never contains digits; numbers are spelled out.

lowerExtra.ar: قد تنخفض النتيجة لأسباب يومية كثيرة، مثل التعب أو الألم أو وقت اليوم أو طريقة التجهيز. يمكنك إعادة القياس بعد بضعة أيام.
lowerExtra.en: Many everyday things can lower a result, such as tiredness, pain, the time of day or the setup. You can check again in a few days.

largeDrop.rule: When the result is lower than baseline by more than 2 x band and no noVerdict condition or quality flag applies (range_below_baseline, range_mismatch, gravity reference, countSource self, more than 10 percent unscored, fewer than 2 valid attempts): no verdict label; show this text and the values, and offer a repeat in 2 to 7 days. If the drop repeats at that re-check without a quality flag, the verdict is lower with lowerExtra. With a quality flag the values are shown with the matching noVerdict sentence and no large drop text.

text.ar: هذه النتيجة أقل بكثير من نقطة بدايتك. قد تتغير النتيجة كثيرًا بسبب التجهيز أو التعب أو الألم أو وقت اليوم. يمكنك إعادة القياس بعد بضعة أيام.
text.en: This result is much lower than your starting point. Setup, tiredness, pain or the time of day can change a result a lot. You can check again in a few days.

largeDrop.oneSidedRule: For the tests with sides (abduction, arm curl, side lean): when a result is more than 2 x band below baseline on one side only (the other side of the same test is not lower, or only one side was tested today), whatever the quality flags, the end of check symptom question (endOfCheck ec_symptoms) uses its side form, naming that side. The question asks about symptoms; the app never interprets the drop itself as a medical sign (Q23).
largeDrop.symptomAsk: Replaced in v1.1 by the end of check symptom question asked of everyone (endOfCheck ec_symptoms, Q23).

shoulderPain.ar: يتغير ألم الكتف من يوم إلى آخر، لذلك نعرض أرقامك دون أن نعدّها تغيرًا.
shoulderPain.en: Shoulder pain changes from day to day, so we show your numbers without calling a change.

setupDiffers.ar: قد يكون التجهيز أو الكرسي مختلفًا هذه المرة، لذلك نعرض أرقامك دون أن نعدّها تغيرًا.
setupDiffers.en: The setup or chair may differ this time, so we show your numbers without calling a change.

movementDifferent.ar: بدت الحركة مختلفة هذه المرة، لذلك لم نقارن.
movementDifferent.en: The movement looked different this time, so we did not compare.

chairLimit.ar: يحدّ الكرسي من مدى ميلك الذي تراه الكاميرا، لذلك نعرض أرقامك دون أن نعدّها تغيرًا.
chairLimit.en: The chair limits how far the camera can see you lean, so we show your numbers without calling a change.

oneValid.ar: استطعنا قياس محاولة واحدة فقط هذه المرة، لذلك نعرض رقمك دون أن نعدّه تغيرًا.
oneValid.en: We could measure only one try this time, so we show your number without calling a change.

selfCount.ar: عدّلت العدد بنفسك هذه المرة، لذلك نعرضه دون أن نعدّه تغيرًا.
selfCount.en: You corrected the count yourself this time, so we show it without calling a change.

startingPointSet.en: Your starting point is now set.

notComparable.ar: لم نقارن هذه المرة لأن طريقة القياس اختلفت، مثل تغيير الوزن أو الكرسي أو نسخة الاختبار. تبدأ هذه النتيجة سلسلة مقارنة جديدة.
notComparable.en: Not compared this time, because the setup was different, for example a different weight, chair or test version. This result starts a new line of comparison.

nearFullRange.ar: نتيجتك في المرتين قريبة من أعلى ما تستطيع الكاميرا قياسه، لذلك لا يمكن أن يظهر هنا تغير واضح.
nearFullRange.en: Both times, your result is near the top of what the camera can measure, so a clear change cannot show here.

unconfirmed.ar: نعدّ هذه النتيجة الآن قريبة من نقطة بدايتك، وسننظر مجددًا في قياسك القادم قبل أن نعدّها تغيرًا.
unconfirmed.en: For now we read this as about the same. We will look again at your next check before we call it a change.

milestone.ar: أجريت اختبار الوقوف من الكرسي هذه المرة دون الاستعانة بيديك.
milestone.en: This time you did the chair stand without using your hands.

nextDue.ar: موعد قياسك القادم {date}. يمكنك القياس قبل ذلك، بعد يومين على الأقل من قياسك الأخير.
nextDue.en: Your next check is due on {date}. You can check earlier, at least 2 days after your last check.

sideLeanSecondBaseline.window: 48 hours to 7 days after the first completed home check
sideLeanSecondBaseline.rule: The app offers a side lean only session. It is a full movement check with one selected test, never a shortcut: the whole pre-check (the every check items including pc_after_last and pc_faint_since when due; the SCI items pc_sci_ad_since, pc_sci_ad_now, pc_sci_ready and warn_sci_t6; the side lean items pc_pressure_sore, pc_sit_unsupported, pc_fall_sitting, pc_stroke_push, the split pc_trunk_armrests, and pc_helper with scr_helper_brief_trunk), then the sound check, the stop list and, when it is on, the check in, bt_pain_after, the end of check symptom question, and ac_next_day afterwards. It is not offered while a lock, an uncleared changeReported or an unresolved lasting ac_next_day answer is active. It counts as a completed check for the 48 hour minimum and does not move the due date of the next full check; the series logic treats it as the second baseline check. If it is not done within 7 days, the next scheduled check becomes the second baseline check as in v1.

offer.ar: لتكون نقطة بدايتك في الميل الجانبي أدق، نعيد هذا الاختبار وحده مرة واحدة بعد يومين إلى سبعة أيام. يستغرق بضع دقائق، على الكرسي نفسه ومع مساعدك إن كنت تحتاج إليه.
offer.en: To make your side lean starting point more accurate, we repeat this test on its own once, 2 to 7 days from now. It takes a few minutes, on the same chair and with your helper if you need one.

cues.ar: لنقِس حركتك الآن، لتتابعها بنفسك. خذ وقتك.
cues.arTts: لِنَقِسْ حَرَكَتَكَ الْآنْ، لِتُتَابِعَهَا بِنَفْسِكْ. خُذْ وَقْتَكْ.
cues.en: Let’s measure your movement now, for your own tracking. Take your time.
Can you hear this sound?

cues.ar: توقف في أي وقت إذا شعرت بألم أو بأنك لست بخير.
cues.arTts: تَوَقَّفْ فِي أَيِّ وَقْتٍ إِذَا شَعَرْتَ بِأَلَمٍ أَوْ بِأَنَّكَ لَسْتَ بِخَيْرْ.
cues.en: Stop at any time if you feel pain or feel unwell.

cues.ar: ضع الهاتف واقفًا على شيء ثابت.
cues.arTts: ضَعِ الْهَاتِفَ وَاقِفًا عَلَى شَيْءٍ ثَابِتْ.
cues.en: Stand the phone upright on something steady.
Keep the phone upright and level.
Keep the phone still.

cues.ar: تحرك حتى يظهر جسمك كاملًا في الصورة.
cues.arTts: تَحَرَّكْ حَتَّى يَظْهَرَ جِسْمُكَ كَامِلًا فِي الصُّورَةْ.
cues.en: Move until your whole body is in the picture.
Face the phone.
Turn so your left side faces the phone.
Turn so your right side faces the phone.

cues.ar: ضع الهاتف في منتصف المسافة بين أمامك وجانبك الأيمن.
cues.arTts: ضَعِ الْهَاتِفَ فِي مُنْتَصَفِ الْمَسَافَةِ بَيْنَ أَمَامِكَ وَجَانِبِكَ الْأَيْمَنْ.
cues.en: Place the phone halfway between straight ahead and your right side.

cues.ar: ضع الهاتف في منتصف المسافة بين أمامك وجانبك الأيسر.
cues.arTts: ضَعِ الْهَاتِفَ فِي مُنْتَصَفِ الْمَسَافَةِ بَيْنَ أَمَامِكَ وَجَانِبِكَ الْأَيْسَرْ.
cues.en: Place the phone halfway between straight ahead and your left side.
Move back a little.
Come a little closer.
Add some light in front of you.

cues.ar: تأكد ألا يقف أحد بينك وبين الهاتف.
cues.arTts: تَأَكَّدْ أَلَّا يَقِفَ أَحَدٌ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الْهَاتِفْ.
cues.en: Make sure no one stands between you and the phone.

cues.ar: تأكد ألا يكون شيء بينك وبين الهاتف.
cues.arTts: تَأَكَّدْ أَلَّا يَكُونَ شَيْءٌ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الْهَاتِفْ.
cues.en: Make sure nothing is between you and the phone.

cues.ar: الأكمام الضيقة تساعد الكاميرا على رؤية مرفقيك.
cues.arTts: الْأَكْمَامُ الضَّيِّقَةُ تُسَاعِدُ الْكَامِيرَا عَلَى رُؤْيَةِ مِرْفَقَيْكْ.
cues.en: Fitted sleeves help the camera see your elbows.
Get ready.
Go.
Ten seconds left.
Time is up. Sit down slowly. Well done.

cues.ar: انتهى الوقت. أنزل ذراعك بهدوء. أحسنت.
cues.arTts: اِنْتَهَى الْوَقْتْ. أَنْزِلْ ذِرَاعَكَ بِهُدُوءْ. أَحْسَنْتْ.
cues.en: Time is up. Lower your arm slowly. Well done.
First, two slow practice movements.
Good. Rest a moment before the test.
Rest a moment.
Rest for one minute.
Now the other side.
Now your left arm.
Now your right arm.
Result saved.
Let’s try once more.
Breathe normally.
Stop now and rest.
What made you stop?

cues.ar: هل أنت بخير؟ إذا كنت بخير، فالمس «أنا بخير».
cues.arTts: هَلْ أَنْتَ بِخَيْرْ؟ إِذَا كُنْتَ بِخَيْرْ، فَالْمِسْ، أَنَا بِخَيْرْ.
cues.en: Are you all right? If you are fine, tap “I am fine”.
Did you pass out, even for a moment?
That is fine. We will skip this test.
Let’s do the check on another day.

cues.ar: ابقَ جالسًا دقيقة واحدة، ثم انهض ببطء.
cues.arTts: اِبْقَ جَالِسًا دَقِيقَةً وَاحِدَةْ، ثُمَّ انْهَضْ بِبُطْءْ.
cues.en: Stay seated for one minute, then get up slowly.
The check is complete. Thank you.

cues.ar: اجلس مستقيمًا، وظهرك مستند إلى الكرسي.
cues.arTts: اِجْلِسْ مُسْتَقِيمًا، وَظَهْرُكَ مُسْتَنِدٌ إِلَى الْكُرْسِيّ.
cues.en: Sit tall with your back against the chair.
Rest both arms by your sides.
Arm straight, thumb pointing up.

cues.ar: ارفع ذراعك إلى الجانب، إلى أعلى ارتفاع مريح.
cues.arTts: اِرْفَعْ ذِرَاعَكَ إِلَى الْجَانِبْ، إِلَى أَعْلَى ارْتِفَاعٍ مُرِيحْ.
cues.en: Raise your arm to the side, as high as is comfortable.

cues.ar: ارفع ذراعك إلى الجانب، لا إلى الأمام.
cues.arTts: اِرْفَعْ ذِرَاعَكَ إِلَى الْجَانِبْ، لَا إِلَى الْأَمَامْ.
cues.en: Raise your arm out to the side, not in front of you.
Hold your arm there.
Now lower it slowly.

cues.ar: أبقِ جسمك ثابتًا دون أن تميل.
cues.arTts: أَبْقِ جِسْمَكَ ثَابِتًا دُونَ أَنْ تَمِيلْ.
cues.en: Keep your body still, without leaning.
Let your shoulder relax, away from your ear.

cues.ar: اجلس مستقيمًا، ودع ذراعك تتدلى إلى الأسفل.
cues.arTts: اِجْلِسْ مُسْتَقِيمًا، وَدَعْ ذِرَاعَكَ تَتَدَلَّى إِلَى الْأَسْفَلْ.
cues.en: Sit tall and let your arm hang straight down.
Keep your elbow close to your body.

cues.ar: اثنِ ذراعك إلى الأعلى تمامًا، ثم مُدّها إلى الأسفل تمامًا.
cues.arTts: اِثْنِ ذِرَاعَكَ إِلَى الْأَعْلَى تَمَامًا، ثُمَّ مُدَّهَا إِلَى الْأَسْفَلِ تَمَامًا.
cues.en: Bend all the way up, then straighten all the way down.

cues.ar: بعد إشارة البدء، أكمل أكبر عدد من الثنيات الكاملة تستطيعه بأمان.
cues.arTts: بَعْدَ إِشَارَةِ الْبَدْءْ، أَكْمِلْ أَكْبَرَ عَدَدٍ مِنَ الثَّنَيَاتِ الْكَامِلَةِ تَسْتَطِيعُهُ بِأَمَانْ.
cues.en: After the start signal, do as many full bends as you safely can.

cues.ar: إذا بدأ الوزن ينزلق من يدك، فتوقف وضعه جانبًا.
cues.arTts: إِذَا بَدَأَ الْوَزْنُ يَنْزَلِقُ مِنْ يَدِكْ، فَتَوَقَّفْ وَضَعْهُ جَانِبًا.
cues.en: If your grip slips, stop and put the weight down.

cues.ar: اجلس مستقيمًا وثابتًا، ويداك على فخذيك.
cues.arTts: اِجْلِسْ مُسْتَقِيمًا وَثَابِتًا، وَيَدَاكَ عَلَى فَخِذَيْكْ.
cues.en: Sit tall and still, hands resting on your thighs.
Stay still for a moment.

cues.ar: مِل ببطء إلى يسارك، فقط بالقدر الذي تثق أنك تعود منه بنفسك.
cues.arTts: مِلْ بِبُطْءٍ إِلَى يَسَارِكْ، فَقَطْ بِالْقَدْرِ الَّذِي تَثِقُ أَنَّكَ تَعُودُ مِنْهُ بِنَفْسِكْ.
cues.en: Slowly lean to your left, only as far as you are sure you can come back from on your own.

cues.ar: مِل ببطء إلى يمينك، فقط بالقدر الذي تثق أنك تعود منه بنفسك.
cues.arTts: مِلْ بِبُطْءٍ إِلَى يَمِينِكْ، فَقَطْ بِالْقَدْرِ الَّذِي تَثِقُ أَنَّكَ تَعُودُ مِنْهُ بِنَفْسِكْ.
cues.en: Slowly lean to your right, only as far as you are sure you can come back from on your own.

cues.ar: دع يدك تنزلق بخفة، دون ضغط.
cues.arTts: دَعْ يَدَكَ تَنْزَلِقُ بِخِفَّةْ، دُونَ ضَغْطْ.
cues.en: Let your hand slide lightly, without pushing.
Hold there a moment.
Now come back and sit tall.

cues.ar: ابقَ على المقعد، وأبقِ قدميك ثابتتين.
cues.arTts: اِبْقَ عَلَى الْمَقْعَدْ، وَأَبْقِ قَدَمَيْكَ ثَابِتَتَيْنْ.
cues.en: Stay on the seat and keep your feet still.
Slowly now, come back to the middle.

cues.ar: اجلس في منتصف الكرسي، وقدماك على الأرض.
cues.arTts: اِجْلِسْ فِي مُنْتَصَفِ الْكُرْسِيّ، وَقَدَمَاكَ عَلَى الْأَرْضْ.
cues.en: Sit in the middle of the chair, feet flat on the floor.
Cross your arms on your chest.

cues.ar: يمكنك الاستعانة بيديك للنهوض، ثم ارفعهما عن السند عندما تقف.
cues.arTts: يُمْكِنُكَ الِاسْتِعَانَةُ بِيَدَيْكَ لِلنُّهُوضْ، ثُمَّ ارْفَعْهُمَا عَنِ السَّنَدِ عِنْدَمَا تَقِفْ.
cues.en: You may push with your hands, then take them off the support when you are standing.

cues.ar: قف مستقيمًا تمامًا، ثم اجلس على المقعد بالكامل.
cues.arTts: قِفْ مُسْتَقِيمًا تَمَامًا، ثُمَّ اجْلِسْ عَلَى الْمَقْعَدِ بِالْكَامِلْ.
cues.en: Stand up fully, then sit all the way down.

cues.ar: بعد إشارة البدء، قف واجلس أكبر عدد من المرات تستطيعه بأمان.
cues.arTts: بَعْدَ إِشَارَةِ الْبَدْءْ، قِفْ وَاجْلِسْ أَكْبَرَ عَدَدٍ مِنَ الْمَرَّاتِ تَسْتَطِيعُهُ بِأَمَانْ.
cues.en: After the start signal, stand up and sit down as many times as you safely can.
Take a moment to feel steady.
If you feel light headed, sit and rest.

cues.ar: احتجت إلى يديك، ولا بأس في ذلك. اجلس واسترح.
cues.arTts: اِحْتَجْتَ إِلَى يَدَيْكْ، وَلَا بَأْسَ فِي ذَلِكْ. اِجْلِسْ وَاسْتَرِحْ.
cues.en: You needed your hands. That is fine. Sit and rest.

cueShortRule: Every cue carries short {ar, en} (O24-1): the caption short form, set at 56 px beside its icon above the full sentence at 34 px, readable from 2 m, never truncated (the video shrinks instead). At most 3 words, an imperative or a noun, no punctuation except a question mark, Western digits in Arabic too (997, D-036 item 3). A safety short form keeps its action verb and never drops a negation. Exceptions decided by the panel: «ضع يدك في المربع» (4 words, O34-1), «لا يقف أحد أمامك» (4 words, R-12 of the release QA, 2026-10-02: «لا أحد أمامك» read as a statement under «شخص آخر في المنتصف»; the Arabic seat confirms) and the English twins Answer from where you are, Lower your arm slowly and Did you pass out? (O24-1), and Do not get up (R3C-15). Short forms are display only: never spoken, no arTts, and they never replace the full sentence, which stays in the caption. A short form never turns a condition or a qualifier of its full cue into an absolute order, and keeps the cue’s mood, so permission stays permission: «لا تنهض لتجيب» · Do not get up (the English form proposed by council R3C-15 so it carries the safety meaning; the Arabic seat confirms), «ينزلق؟ ضعه جانبًا» · Slipping? Put down, «يمكنك الاستعانة بيديك» · Hands may help (Arabic seat, review fixes of 2026-09-28).

voicePending.ttsConvention: arTts is fully vocalised and matches the display text word for word (numbers spelled out). Every word before a pause (comma, full stop, question mark) takes its pausal form: sukun on the last letter (also on ة), tanween fath with alif kept as written, a final long vowel or shadda left as is. A word that starts a breath group after a comma carries the vowel of its hamzat al wasl (اِرْفَعْ). A quoted phrase in the display text («أنا بخير») is spoken with a short pause on each side, written as a comma in arTts, and the word before the pause takes its pausal form; a question mark or full stop inside quotation marks is not a sentence end. The UI splits the display text and its arTts at the same full stops and question marks outside quotation marks; a split never falls inside a sentence, and a sentence naming 997 is never truncated in the caption. A build lint checks that the arTts sentence count equals the display sentence count for every text and fails the build on a mismatch, which goes back to the Arabic seat; a mismatch that reaches runtime plays the line whole with no highlight (7.2-12). Codes are spoken as letters and numbers (T6: تِي سِتَّةْ).

At the booth none of the pre-check lines plays by itself (B16).

ask.ar: كيف تحب أن نخاطبك؟
ask.en: How would you like us to address you in Arabic?

addressPreference.v1: v1 keeps the masculine singular default. New movement check lines prefer forms that need no gender where they stay natural, such as the first person plural (لنبدأ، لنقِس، لنؤجل) and noun headings, without forcing it.
addressPreference.set: Phase 2 ships a complete feminine set, display and voice, for the check and the coach, before the first pilot participant, reviewed by a woman co-designer (H8) and approved by ear by Nasser. Each feminine line keeps the wording, order and timing of its masculine twin, so the timed test script stays the same and switching never breaks a series.
addressPreference.storage: A display preference only: not a sex field, never used for weight guidance, analytics or any other purpose, stored only as the chosen form, and not a comparability field.

selection.gate: The check is offered only when contextFromIntake returns a context. It returns null for mobility bed and for the clinical plan review reasons only: cardiac, symptoms, recent_change, restriction (no_exercise), unknown_condition (other), clearance (stroke, sci_complete, sci_incomplete without clearance yes, with the booth rule of Q19), pem (cfs_moderate), unsupported_position. The plan's scheduling reasons (recovery, duration, no_exercises) never block the check; the gate reads only the clinical review reasons from the plan output (Q20).
selection.substitution: Standing position: when chair_stand_30s is excluded by an intake level rule (pain hip, knee or back; no_weight_bearing; balance_support; sci_complete; lower_limb_unilateral; clearance no or unsure), trunk_control_seated takes its place in the same slot, if it is not excluded itself. Whenever the substitute actually runs, the chair stand's skip reason gets reasonSuffixes.substituteRan (P6). Same day skips (helper_needed, chair_needed, pain today, flare) do not trigger a substitute.
selection.order: Fixed order as listed in basePerPosition (the substitute keeps the slot). Standing: the 1 minute seated rest after the chair stand runs before the arm curl.

setting.booth: Staff present. Staff stand within arm’s reach, hands ready and not touching; they may be in the picture but never between the phone and the person. They never lift, guide or steady an arm to help a movement. If the person loses balance they catch at once, at the waist, hips or trunk, never by the arm; that attempt is discarded and the test stops. Allowed only at the booth: trunk_control_seated for balance_support, pc_sit_unsupported no or unsure, pc_fall_sitting yes (not pc_stroke_push yes, which is excluded in v1). At the booth the arm curl runs arm_only for everyone and the load screens are not shown (Q5); stroke or SCI with clearance no or not sure runs the seated arm raise only (Q19); the phone, support and staff positions of the chair stand are fixed once for every visitor (P4); staff may read questions aloud and tap the answer the person says, never answering for them and never overriding a block (Q18, Q19). A signed in visitor always runs in booth mode after staff enter the booth code, so results carry setting booth and form their own series; the home series starts at home (Q19).

selection.clearance: Intake clearance no or unsure (only possible for conditions that do not require clearance): arm curl uses arm_only; the chair stand is not offered, at home or at the booth (reason clearance), and the seated side lean takes its slot as for the other intake level exclusions (3.2); abduction and trunk control run as normal (Q6). Stroke and SCI without clearance yes follow 3.1, with the booth rule of Q19. D-016 (Nasser, 2026-09-30) replaces the booth blood pressure and heart rate check of Q21 and O47: there is no cuff and no staff vitals screen.

conditionsStep.chips: One screen of large chips with the intake condition labels exactly, with لا شيء مما سبق · None of these first.

ask.ar: هل سمح لك الطبيب بممارسة التمرين؟
ask.en: Has your doctor cleared you to exercise?

hint.ar: نقصد أن يكون طبيبك قد أخبرك بذلك. إذا أخبرك به أخصائي العلاج الطبيعي أو الوظيفي وحده، فاختر «لست متأكدًا».
hint.en: We mean that your doctor told you so. If only your physiotherapist or occupational therapist told you, choose “Not sure”.
hint.status: O39, amended in the review fixes (2026-09-28): «المعالج» alone can also mean a traditional healer in Saudi use, and physiotherapists are often addressed as «دكتور», so the hint names the physiotherapist and the occupational therapist. Shown under the Q19 question, which stays word for word, once Nasser ratifies the amended text as an addition to Q19; in the guest step first, and in the intake with the O44 label switch, so that both say the same. It goes through the Q18 (6) testing with the clearance question. Confirmed by the Arabic seat (2026-09-28).

clearance.rule: Every guest answers the intake's existing medical clearance question word for word; its English twin becomes Has your doctor cleared you to exercise? in both the intake and the guest flow. A skipped answer counts as not sure. The full pre-check then runs.

guestBooth.answering: The person answers personally. Staff may read the questions aloud and tap the answer the person gives, but never answer for them and never override a block.
guestBooth.privacy: Answers are evaluated on the device only: nothing is sent to the server, logged or put in analytics, and the booth device resets visibly with no autofill after each guest.
routing: cardiac, other, cfs_moderate, bed, or the no_exercise restriction: no movement check; show scr_booth_no_check. Staff then show the labelled example progress view (progress.boothExample) and the demo video, never a camera test.

stroke, sci_complete or sci_incomplete with clearance no or not sure (booth only rule): the seated arm raise only, active movement only and without load, with all its rules (pc_weak_lift, pc_weak_shoulder, thumb up) and staff within arm's reach. The side lean, the arm curl and the chair stand are skipped with reason clearance_booth.
Everyone else follows 3.1 and 3.3, including Q6 and D-016 for clearance no or not sure (arm curl without weight; no chair stand, the seated side lean in its slot).
guestBooth.signedIn: A signed in visitor at the booth runs the check as a guest on a staff booth phone (simplicity cut C34), so nothing of it is kept; the S50 code is the way to sign up, and the home series starts at home.

homeGates.target: 31 October 2026; if a gate is not met by then, the movement check stays in booth mode only until it is.
homeGates.cognitiveTestMethod: 5 to 8 users in each group whose screens are tested, never fewer than 5, including at least 5 people living with SCI for the AD screens (pc_sci_level, warn_sci_t6, pc_sci_ad_now, pc_sci_ready, scr_ad); each group includes women, adults over 60 and at least one person who reads little or uses a screen reader; screens are also tested by ear; scripted scenarios, not the participant's own health answers; a written paid participation agreement; no names in notes; no audio or video recording without separate consent; ethics approval if the findings will be published. The co-designers (H8) may take part. The other new questions go through the same testing before the first pilot participant (Q18 (6)). At least 5 people living with aphasia after stroke join the testing of pc_urgent and ec_symptoms (O37); the examples lists of pc_change and pc_unwell, with their speech lines, and the clearance question with its O39 hint are tested before the first pilot participant (O45, O39).

sessionMinutes.computed: estimateMinutes (UX spec S27): a range [min, max] of a check at home, from the tests and the helper briefings. Every home screen states it through statedMinutes (simplicity cut C11): the tests with the worst case context, so the same tests show the same range on S01, S02 and S27, and a stated range only lengthens. The booth states no time (D-017 item 1, Nasser, 2 October 2026): no minutes or duration estimate on S05, S27 or any other booth screen, cue or caption, so there is no booth reading and no guest steps estimate.
sessionMinutes.includes: Every estimate includes every rest (the 60 s side change, the seated minute after the chair stand, rests after stops), practice, the answers and the pre-check; none of these is ever shortened to meet a time target (O40).
sessionMinutes.status: Estimates until home checks are timed; the measured medians then replace them here and in S27 at home.
sessionMinutes.target: Council F-2 (30 September 2026): the booth default is the one test path, which staff offer first; the full check stays optional and is never hidden. F1: a wheelchair user finishes the booth one test path, from the tap on S05 to the results (S50), in a median of 12 minutes or less, in Arabic and in English, with no rest, practice, attempt, side, answer or pre-check item cut. This is a staff target only: the booth states no time (D-017 item 1). At home a measured median above a stated range lengthens these estimates; it never shortens them (O40).
